questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Peter answered 15 quiz questions for 29 points. A correct answer earns 3 points and a wrong answer loses 1 point. How many were correct?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the total number of questions and compare the score from correct and wrong answers.

steps.title: Set up the counts
steps.text: Let c be the number correct. Then 15 − c were wrong, so 3c − (15 − c) = 29.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用答对和答错的题数总和为 15，再列出得分关系。

steps.title: 设答对题数
steps.text: 设答对 c 题，则答错 15 − c 题。得分是 3c − (15 − c) = 29。

questions.questionZh: 彼得答了15道测验题，共得29分。答对1题得3分，答错1题扣1分。彼得答对了多少题？

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: A box had 480 yellow, orange, and black beads. After 18 yellow beads were added, 33 orange beads were removed, and black beads were doubled, the 3 colours were equal. Find each original count.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Work backward from the equal final number of each colour.

steps.title: Represent the final equal amount
steps.text: Let the final amount of each colour be x. Originally, yellow was x − 18, orange was x + 33, and black was x ÷ 2 because it was doubled.

zh-Hans.strategy: 从三种珠子最后数量相等的状态倒推。

steps.title: 设最后相等的数量
steps.text: 设每种颜色最后都有 x 颗。原来黄珠有 x − 18 颗，橙珠有 x + 33 颗，黑珠有 x ÷ 2 颗，因为黑珠数量加倍了。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 黄珠 168 颗；橙珠 219 颗；黑珠 93 颗。

questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里有480颗黄色、橙色和黑色珠子。加入18颗黄色珠子、取走33颗橙色珠子，并把黑色珠子的数量增加到原来的2倍后，3种颜色的珠子数量相等。求每种珠子原来的数量。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 40% of Angie’s beads were red. After she lost 50 blue beads, the number of blue beads was reduced by 1/3 of its original count. How many beads did Angie have in the end?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the loss to find the original number of blue beads, then use the 40% red split.

steps.title: Find the original blue beads
steps.text: The 50 lost blue beads are 1/3 of the original blue beads. Original blue beads = 50 × 3 = 150.

steps.title: Find the final total
steps.text: Since 40% were red, 60% were blue. The original total was 150 ÷ 60% = 250. After 50 blue beads were lost, 250 − 50 = 200.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用丢失的蓝珠数求原来蓝珠数，再利用红珠占40%的关系。

steps.title: 求原来蓝珠数
steps.text: 丢失的50颗蓝珠是原来蓝珠数的1/3，所以原来蓝珠有50 × 3 = 150颗。

steps.title: 求最后总数
steps.text: 红珠占40%，所以蓝珠占60%。原来总数是150 ÷ 60% = 250颗。丢失50颗蓝珠后，剩下250 − 50 = 200颗。

questions.questionZh: 安琪的珠子中有40%是红色的。她丢失50颗蓝色珠子后，蓝色珠子的数量减少了原来的1/3。安琪最后有多少颗珠子？
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: There were 820 orange buttons, 160 fewer than yellow buttons and 210 more than green buttons. Blue buttons were 1/3 of the total. How many buttons were there altogether?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the yellow and green counts first; the three non-blue colours make up 2/3 of the total.

steps.title: Count the non-blue buttons
steps.text: Yellow = 820 + 160 = 980. Green = 820 − 210 = 610. Orange, yellow, and green total 820 + 980 + 610 = 2410.

steps.title: Find the whole total
steps.text: Blue buttons are 1/3 of the total, so the 2410 non-blue buttons are 2/3. Total buttons = 2410 ÷ 2 × 3 = 3615.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求黄色和绿色纽扣数；3种非蓝色纽扣占总数的2/3。

steps.title: 求总数
steps.text: 蓝色纽扣占总数的1/3，所以2410个非蓝色纽扣占2/3。纽扣总数为2410 ÷ 2 × 3 = 3615个。

questions.questionZh: 有820个橙色纽扣，比黄色纽扣少160个，比绿色纽扣多210个。蓝色纽扣占总数的1/3。纽扣一共有多少个？

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Benjamin sold apples and oranges. He sold 2 more apples; oranges cost $3, apples $2, and he received $1 for every 10 fruit. The sale total after payment was $62. Find each count.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 2-fruit difference and account for Benjamin's $1 per complete 10-fruit group.

steps.title: Express the fruit counts
steps.text: Let oranges = x, so apples = x + 2. The fruit value before payment is 3x + 2(x + 2) = 5x + 4 dollars.

steps.title: Account for the payment
steps.text: With x = 12, there are 12 + 14 = 26 fruit, or 2 complete groups of 10, so Benjamin receives $2. The seller keeps $62, making the fruit value $62 + $2 = $64.

steps.title: Solve and check
steps.text: 5x + 4 = 64 gives x = 12. Therefore there were 12 oranges and 14 apples; 12×$3 + 14×$2 − $2 = $62.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用苹果比橙子多 2 个，并扣除每完整 10 个水果的 $1 报酬。

steps.title: 表示水果数量
steps.text: 设橙子有 x 个，苹果有 x + 2 个。付报酬前的水果售价为 3x + 2(x + 2) = 5x + 4 美元。

steps.title: 计算报酬
steps.text: 当 x = 12 时，水果共 12 + 14 = 26 个，有 2 组完整的 10 个，所以 Benjamin 得到 $2。卖家收 $62，水果售价应为 $62 + $2 = $64。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 橙子 12 个；苹果 14 个。

questions.questionZh: 本杰明卖苹果和橙子。他卖的苹果比橙子多2个；橙子每个$3，苹果每个$2，并且每卖出10个水果可获得$1。收款后总销售额为$62。求苹果和橙子各卖了多少个。
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 160 paperclips were in 4 boxes A, B, C, and D. 12 paperclips were moved from A to B, 1/3 of the paperclips in B were moved to C, and 17 paperclips were moved from D to C. The boxes then contained equal numbers of paperclips. Find the original number in each box.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the common final amount, then reverse each transfer.

steps.title: Find the final amount per box
steps.text: The total stays 160, so each of the 4 boxes finally has 160 ÷ 4 = 40 paperclips. Thus A started with 40 + 12 = 52 and D started with 40 + 17 = 57.

steps.title: Reverse the transfer from B
steps.text: After 12 arrived in B, 1/3 was moved, leaving 2/3 equal to 40. So B had 40 ÷ 2 × 3 = 60 then, and originally had 60 − 12 = 48. The transfer to C was 60 ÷ 3 = 20, so C originally had 40 − 20 − 17 = 3.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求每盒最后相等的数量，再倒推每次移动。

steps.title: 求每盒最后数量
steps.text: 总数仍是160，所以4个盒子最后各有160 ÷ 4 = 40个回形针。因此A原来有40 + 12 = 52个，D原来有40 + 17 = 57个。

steps.title: 倒推B到C的移动
steps.text: 12个移入B后，移走1/3，剩下的2/3是40个。因此B当时有40 ÷ 2 × 3 = 60个，原来有60 − 12 = 48个。移到C的是60 ÷ 3 = 20个，所以C原来有40 − 20 − 17 = 3个。

questions.questionZh: 160个回形针放在A、B、C、D四个盒子里。将12个回形针从A移到B，把B中回形针的1/3移到C，再将17个回形针从D移到C后，4个盒子里的回形针数量相等。求各盒原来的数量。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Michael had 80% more money than Alvin; Vanessa had 40% less. Michael and Alvin gave Vanessa money in a 3:2 ratio. Vanessa then had 2 times her original amount; Michael ended $144 above Vanessa. Find original amounts.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Alvin's amount as a common unit, then split the transfer in the 3:2 ratio.

steps.title: Make a unit model
steps.text: Let Alvin have 5 units. Michael has 80% more, or 9 units; Vanessa has 40% less, or 3 units.

steps.title: Find the transfers
steps.text: Vanessa finishes with twice 3 units, so she receives 3 units. Split in the 3:2 ratio: Michael gives 9/5 × 3 = 9/5 units and Alvin gives 6/5 units.

steps.title: Use the final difference
steps.text: Michael ends with 9 − 9/5 = 36/5 units; Vanessa ends with 6 units. Their difference is 6/5 units = $144, so 1 unit = $120. Original amounts are $1080, $600, and $360.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把 Alvin 的钱设为单位，再按 3:2 分配给 Vanessa 的钱。

steps.title: 建立单位模型
steps.text: 设 Alvin 有 5 份。Michael 多 80%，有 9 份；Vanessa 少 40%，有 3 份。

steps.title: 求转给 Vanessa 的钱
steps.text: Vanessa 最后有原来的 2 倍，即从 3 份变为 6 份，所以共收到 3 份。按 3:2，Michael 给 9/5×3 = 9/5 份，Alvin 给 6/5 份。

steps.title: 利用最后的差
steps.text: Michael 最后有 9 − 9/5 = 36/5 份，Vanessa 最后有 6 份，相差 6/5 份 = $144。因此 1 份 = $120，原来分别有 $1080、$600、$360。

questions.questionZh: 迈克尔的钱比阿尔文多80%；瓦妮莎的钱比阿尔文少40%。迈克尔和阿尔文按3:2的比例给瓦妮莎钱。之后瓦妮莎的钱变为原来的2倍；迈克尔最后比瓦妮莎多$144。求三人原来各有多少钱。
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 2/5 of Tom’s toy cars were red. The number of green cars was 35 more than the number of red cars, and the remaining 15 cars were yellow. The cars were packed 5 to a box, with a single colour in each box. How many more red-and-green boxes than yellow boxes were there?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use fifths for the total, then convert each colour count into boxes.

steps.title: Find the number of cars
steps.text: Let the total be 5 units. Red = 2 units, green = 2 units + 35, and yellow = 15. So 2u + (2u + 35) + 15 = 5u, giving u = 50. Red = 100 and green = 135.

steps.title: Pack the cars
steps.text: Red cars fill 100 ÷ 5 = 20 boxes and green cars fill 135 ÷ 5 = 27 boxes. Yellow cars fill 15 ÷ 5 = 3 boxes. The difference is 20 + 27 − 3 = 44 boxes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把总数看成5份，求出各色数量后再按每盒5辆装箱。

steps.title: 求各色玩具车数
steps.text: 设总数为5份，每份为u辆。红车有2u辆，绿车有2u + 35辆，黄车有15辆。2u + (2u + 35) + 15 = 5u，所以u = 50。红车有100辆，绿车有135辆。

questions.questionZh: 汤姆的玩具车中有2/5是红色的。绿色玩具车比红色玩具车多35辆，其余15辆是黄色的。每盒装5辆同色玩具车。红色和绿色玩具车的盒数合计比黄色玩具车的盒数多多少？
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: David had 3/7 as many cards as Kristy. David gave away 9 cards and Kristy bought 18 cards. Their final numbers of cards were in the ratio 2:9. How many cards did they have altogether in the end?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Represent the starting cards in the ratio 3:7 and use the final ratio.

steps.title: Set up the starting amounts
steps.text: Let David and Kristy initially have 3u and 7u cards. After the changes, they have 3u − 9 and 7u + 18 cards.

steps.title: Use the final ratio
steps.text: Their final ratio is 2:9, so 9(3u − 9) = 2(7u + 18). Thus 27u − 81 = 14u + 36, giving u = 9. Their final counts are 18 and 81, for a total of 99.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把起初卡片数表示为3:7，再利用最后的2:9。

steps.title: 表示起初数量
steps.text: 设大卫和克里斯蒂起初分别有3u张和7u张卡片。变化后分别有3u − 9张和7u + 18张。

questions.questionZh: 大卫的卡片数量是克里斯蒂的3/7。大卫送出9张卡片，克里斯蒂买了18张卡片后，两人的卡片数量之比为2:9。最后两人一共有多少张卡片？
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 2/3 of 42 students passed English. Of those who passed, 9/14 were girls. There were 4 more boys than girls among the students who failed. How many girls were in the class?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Count the girls who passed, then split the students who failed using their difference of 4.

steps.title: Find the passing girls
steps.text: Students who passed = 2/3 × 42 = 28. Passing girls = 9/14 × 28 = 18.

steps.title: Find the failing girls
steps.text: There were 42 − 28 = 14 students who failed. If failing girls are g, failing boys are g + 4. So g + (g + 4) = 14, giving g = 5. Total girls = 18 + 5 = 23.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求及格女生人数，再用不及格男生比女生多4人的关系求不及格女生人数。

steps.title: 求不及格女生人数
steps.text: 不及格学生有42 − 28 = 14人。设不及格女生有g人，则不及格男生有g + 4人。g + (g + 4) = 14，所以g = 5。女生总数为18 + 5 = 23人。

questions.questionZh: 42名学生中有2/3通过了英语考试。通过考试的学生中有9/14是女生。未通过考试的男生比女生多4人。班上有多少名女生？
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Mrs Drew sold 120 butter and chocolate-chip cookies. Butter cost $2, chocolate-chip cost $4, and sales were $310. How many more butter cookies were sold?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use one equation for the total cookies and one for the total sales.

steps.title: Write the equations
steps.text: Let b be butter cookies and c be chocolate-chip cookies. Then b + c = 120 and 2b + 4c = 310.

steps.title: Solve
steps.text: Divide the sales equation by 2: b + 2c = 155. Subtract b + c = 120 to get c = 35, so b = 85.

steps.title: Find the difference
steps.text: 85 − 35 = 50 more butter cookies.

zh-Hans.strategy: 一个等式表示饼干总数，另一个等式表示销售额。

steps.title: 列等式
steps.text: 设黄油饼干有 b 个，巧克力碎片饼干有 c 个。则 b + c = 120，2b + 4c = 310。

steps.title: 求两种饼干数量
steps.text: 销售额等式除以 2，得 b + 2c = 155。减去 b + c = 120，得到 c = 35，所以 b = 85。

steps.title: 求相差数量
steps.text: 85 − 35 = 50 个，所以黄油饼干多 50 个。

questions.questionZh: 德鲁太太卖出120块黄油饼干和巧克力碎片饼干。黄油饼干每块$2，巧克力碎片饼干每块$4，总销售额为$310。黄油饼干比巧克力碎片饼干多卖出多少块？
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Jane and John had 180 marbles. After Jane gave John marbles, John had 3 times his original count and Jane had 1/2 of John’s count. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Express both final amounts in terms of John's original number.

steps.title: Use John's original amount
steps.text: Let John originally have j marbles. After Jane gives him some, John has 3j marbles.

steps.title: Use Jane's final relation
steps.text: Jane then has 1/2 of John's final amount, so she has 3j/2 marbles. Their total remains 180.

steps.title: Solve
steps.text: 3j + 3j/2 = 180, so 9j/2 = 180 and j = 40. Jane originally had 180 − 40 = 140 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两人最后的弹珠数都用 John 原来的数量表示。

steps.title: 设 John 原有的数量
steps.text: 设 John 原来有 j 颗弹珠。Jane 给他一些后，John 有 3j 颗。

steps.title: 表示 Jane 最后的数量
steps.text: Jane 最后有 John 最后数量的 1/2，所以她有 3j/2 颗。两人的总数仍是 180 颗。

questions.questionZh: 简和约翰共有180颗弹珠。简给约翰一些弹珠后，约翰的弹珠数量变为原来的3倍，简的弹珠数量是约翰的1/2。求两人原来各有多少颗弹珠。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 3/5 of a number exceeds 1/2 of the number by 12. Find the difference between the number and its fourth multiple.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the difference between 3/5 and 1/2 to find the number.

steps.title: Find the number
steps.text: The fractional difference is 3/5 − 1/2 = 1/10. Therefore 1/10 of the number is 12, so the number is 12 × 10 = 120.

steps.title: Compare with the fourth multiple
steps.text: The fourth multiple is 4 × 120 = 480. The difference is 480 − 120 = 360.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用3/5和1/2的差求这个数。

steps.title: 求这个数
steps.text: 两个分数的差是3/5 − 1/2 = 1/10。因此这个数的1/10是12，所以这个数是12 × 10 = 120。

questions.questionZh: 一个数的3/5比它的1/2多12。求这个数与它的4倍之间的差。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 105 students were in 3 groups. 1/3 of group 1 moved to group 2, and 20% of group 3 moved to group 2. Then 15 students moved from group 1 to group 3. The 3 groups then had equal numbers of students. Find the original number in each group.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Each final group has the same share of 105; reverse the changes in groups 1 and 3.

steps.title: Find groups 1 and 3
steps.text: Each final group has 105 ÷ 3 = 35 students. Group 1 has 2/3 of its original number, then loses 15: 2G₁/3 − 15 = 35. So G₁ = 75. Group 3 has 80% of its original number, then gains 15: 4G₃/5 + 15 = 35. So G₃ = 25.

steps.title: Find group 2
steps.text: The original total was 105, so G₂ = 105 − 75 − 25 = 5. Check: group 2 receives 25 + 5 = 30 students, so it becomes 5 + 30 = 35.

zh-Hans.strategy: 105人最后平均分成3组，先倒推第1组和第3组，再求第2组。

steps.title: 求第1组和第3组
steps.text: 每组最后有105 ÷ 3 = 35人。第1组剩原来的2/3后再调走15人：2G₁/3 − 15 = 35，所以G₁ = 75。第3组剩原来的80%后再调入15人：4G₃/5 + 15 = 35，所以G₃ = 25。

questions.questionZh: 105名学生分成3组。第1组的1/3调到第2组，第3组的20%调到第2组；随后15名学生从第1组调到第3组。此时3组人数相等。求各组原来的人数。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: In 1998, Tom was 4 times Jack’s age and Peter was 2 times Jack’s age. Tom was 36. Find Peter’s age in 2000 and their total age in 2003.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find Jack's 1998 age from Tom's age, then move all ages forward by the required years.

steps.title: Find the 1998 ages
steps.text: Tom was 36 and was 4 times Jack's age, so Jack was 36 ÷ 4 = 9. Peter was twice Jack's age, so Peter was 18 in 1998.

steps.title: Answer part (a)
steps.text: From 1998 to 2000 is 2 years, so Peter was 18 + 2 = 20 years old.

steps.title: Answer part (b)
steps.text: In 2003, Tom, Jack, and Peter were 41, 14, and 23 years old. Their total was 41 + 14 + 23 = 78 years.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先根据 Tom 的年龄求 Jack 在 1998 年的年龄，再把所有人的年龄增加所经过的年数。

steps.title: 求 1998 年的年龄
steps.text: Tom 当时 36 岁，是 Jack 年龄的 4 倍，所以 Jack 是 36 ÷ 4 = 9 岁。Peter 是 Jack 的 2 倍，所以 Peter 在 1998 年是 18 岁。

steps.title: 回答 (a)
steps.text: 从 1998 年到 2000 年经过 2 年，所以 Peter 是 18 + 2 = 20 岁。

steps.title: 回答 (b)
steps.text: 到 2003 年，Tom、Jack、Peter 分别是 41 岁、14 岁、23 岁，总年龄为 41 + 14 + 23 = 78 岁。

questions.questionZh: 1998年，汤姆的年龄是杰克的4倍，彼得的年龄是杰克的2倍。汤姆当时36岁。求彼得在2000年的年龄，以及3人在2003年的年龄总和。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Thomas and Zack were each given the same number of toy cars. Zack then had 2 times as many toy cars as he had at first. 2/3 of Zack’s number then equalled 1/2 of Thomas’s number then. Thomas had 36 more toy cars than Zack then. Find (a) the total number of toy cars given and (b) Thomas’s initial number of toy cars.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Let Zack’s initial number determine the equal gift, then use the final fractional equality and difference.

steps.title: Relate the final numbers
steps.text: Let Zack initially have z cars. Since he then has twice as many, he receives z cars and has 2z. Thomas also receives z cars. From 2/3 of Zack’s final number = 1/2 of Thomas’s final number, 2/3(2z) = 1/2(T + z), so T = 5z/3.

steps.title: Use the 36-car difference
steps.text: Thomas then has T + z = 8z/3 cars, while Zack has 2z. Their difference is 8z/3 − 2z = 2z/3 = 36, so z = 54. The total given is 54 + 54 = 108 cars, and Thomas initially had 5 × 54 ÷ 3 = 90 cars.

zh-Hans.strategy: 设扎克原来的数量为未知数，用相同的赠送数量和最后的分数关系求解。

steps.title: 表示最后的数量
steps.text: 设扎克原来有z辆。后来他有原来的2倍，因此他得到z辆，最后有2z辆。托马斯也得到z辆。由扎克最后数量的2/3 = 托马斯最后数量的1/2，得2/3(2z) = 1/2(T + z)，所以T = 5z/3。

steps.title: 使用相差36辆
steps.text: 托马斯最后有T + z = 8z/3辆，扎克最后有2z辆。相差8z/3 − 2z = 2z/3 = 36，所以z = 54。共送出54 + 54 = 108辆，托马斯原来有5 × 54 ÷ 3 = 90辆。

questions.questionZh: 托马斯和扎克各自得到相同数量的玩具车。扎克后来拥有的玩具车数是他原来数量的2倍。此时扎克玩具车数的2/3等于托马斯玩具车数的1/2，且托马斯比扎克多36辆。求(a)共送出多少辆玩具车，(b)托马斯原来有多少辆玩具车。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: Joanne sold cookies, cakes, and muffins. There were 140 more cookies than cakes. 1/5 of the cookies and 2/3 of the cakes were chocolate. The number of chocolate cookies equalled the number of chocolate cakes. The number of butter cakes equalled the number of butter muffins. The number of cakes was 3/4 of the number of muffins. (a) How many more butter items than chocolate items were there? (b) If a cookie cost $0.50, a cake cost $1.50, and a muffin cost $2, what were the total sales?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the equal chocolate amounts to find cookies and cakes, then use the cake-to-muffin relation.

steps.title: Find each item count
steps.text: Let cakes = K. Cookies = K + 140. Since 1/5 of the cookies equals 2/3 of the cakes, (K + 140)/5 = 2K/3. Thus 3K + 420 = 10K, so K = 60 and cookies = 200. Cakes are 3/4 of muffins, so muffins = 60 × 4/3 = 80.

steps.title: Compare flavours and calculate sales
steps.text: Chocolate cookies and cakes are 40 each. Butter cakes are 60 − 40 = 20, so butter muffins are also 20; chocolate muffins are 80 − 20 = 60. Butter items = 160 + 20 + 20 = 200 and chocolate items = 40 + 40 + 60 = 140, a difference of 60. Sales = 200×$0.50 + 60×$1.50 + 80×$2 = $350.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用两种巧克力食品数量相等求饼干和蛋糕数，再用蛋糕与松饼的关系求松饼数。

steps.title: 求各类食品数量
steps.text: 设蛋糕有K个，则饼干有K + 140个。因为饼干的1/5等于蛋糕的2/3，(K + 140)/5 = 2K/3。于是3K + 420 = 10K，K = 60，饼干有200个。蛋糕数是松饼数的3/4，所以松饼有60 × 4/3 = 80个。

steps.title: 比较口味并计算销售额

questions.questionZh: 乔安妮卖饼干、蛋糕和松饼。饼干比蛋糕多140个。饼干的1/5和蛋糕的2/3是巧克力味。巧克力饼干数等于巧克力蛋糕数，黄油蛋糕数等于黄油松饼数，蛋糕数是松饼数的3/4。(a)黄油味食品比巧克力味食品多多少个？(b)若每个饼干$0.50、每个蛋糕$1.50、每个松饼$2，总销售额是多少？
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 4656 people attended a concert. After 1/4 of men and 1/3 of women left, 120 more women remained. How many more women than men were there at first?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Write equations for the people still in the hall, then use the total of 4656.

steps.title: Express those remaining
steps.text: If there were M men and W women at first, 1/5 of the men remained and 1/4 of the women remained. Thus W/4 = M/5 + 120, and M + W = 4656.

steps.title: Solve the two equations
steps.text: Substitute W = 4656 - M: (4656 - M)/4 = M/5 + 120. Multiplying by 20 gives 23280 - 5M = 4M + 2400, so M = 2320 and W = 2336.

steps.title: Compare the starting groups
steps.text: The difference was 2336 - 2320 = 16, so there were 16 more women than men at first.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把离开后剩下的人数分别表示出来，再利用总人数 4656 列方程。

steps.title: 表示剩下的人数
steps.text: 设原来有 M 名男士、W 名女士。男士离开 4/5，所以剩下 M/5；女士离开 3/4，所以剩下 W/4。因此 W/4 = M/5 + 120，且 M + W = 4656。

steps.title: 比较原来人数
steps.text: 2336 - 2320 = 16，所以原来女士比男士多 16 人。

questions.questionZh: 4656人参加了一场音乐会。1/4的男士和1/3的女士离开后，留下的女士比男士多120人。起初女士比男士多多少人？

questions.topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
questions.question: 1/3 of 120 oranges were ripe and the rest overripe. After 40 were removed, overripe oranges were 3/4 of the remainder. Find removed ripe, removed overripe, and final difference.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find each type before removal, then use the 3/4 condition after 40 oranges are removed.

steps.title: Find the original counts
steps.text: Overripe oranges were 2/3 × 120 = 80, so ripe oranges were 120 - 80 = 40.

steps.title: Find the remaining counts
steps.text: After 40 are removed, 80 oranges remain. Overripe oranges are 3/4 × 80 = 60, so ripe oranges remaining are 80 - 60 = 20.

steps.title: Compare before and after
steps.text: Overripe removed: 80 - 60 = 20. Ripe removed: 40 - 20 = 20. The final difference is 60 - 20 = 40.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求取走前 2 类橙子的数量，再用取走 40 个后过熟橙子占 3/4 的条件。

steps.title: 求原来数量
steps.text: 过熟橙子有 2/3 × 120 = 80 个，所以成熟橙子有 120 - 80 = 40 个。

steps.title: 求取走后数量
steps.text: 取走 40 个后还剩 80 个。过熟橙子为 3/4 × 80 = 60 个，所以成熟橙子还剩 80 - 60 = 20 个。

steps.title: 分别比较
steps.text: 取走过熟橙子 80 - 60 = 20 个；取走成熟橙子 40 - 20 = 20 个；最后相差 60 - 20 = 40 个。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：答案：(a) 20 个过熟橙子；(b) 20 个成熟橙子；(c) 过熟橙子多 40 个。

questions.questionZh: 120个橙子中有1/3成熟，其余过熟。取走40个橙子后，过熟橙子占剩余橙子的3/4。求取走的成熟橙子数、取走的过熟橙子数，以及最后两者数量之差。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Mrs Crawford spent 1/3 of salary on education and 1/4 of the remainder on food. Savings:transport was 2:3; education exceeded transport by $265. Find 6 months of education spending.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the salary as one whole and express education and transport as fractions of it.

steps.title: Split the salary
steps.text: Education is 1/4 of the salary. Food is 2/3 of the remaining 3/4, or 1/2 of the salary. Therefore savings plus transport is the remaining 1/4.

steps.title: Find monthly education
steps.text: Transport is 3/5 of that 1/4, or 3/20 of the salary. Education minus transport is 1/4 - 3/20 = 1/10 of the salary, and this is $265. So the salary is $2650 and monthly education is 1/4 × $2650 = $662.50.

steps.title: Scale to 6 months
steps.text: In 6 months, education spending is 6 × $662.50 = $3975.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把月薪看作 1 整体，把教育费和交通费都表示成月薪的分数。

steps.title: 分配月薪
steps.text: 教育费是月薪的 1/4。食物费是剩余 3/4 的 2/3，即月薪的 1/2。因此储蓄和交通费合共是月薪的 1/4。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：6 个月的教育费 = $3975。

questions.questionZh: 克劳福德太太将工资的1/3用于教育，又将余下部分的1/4用于食物。储蓄与交通费之比为2:3；教育支出比交通费多$265。求6个月的教育支出。
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Tank A was 2/3 full. 1/2 of its water filled tank B from 1/4 full to full. Tank A measured 12 cm × 10 cm × 20 cm. Find total tank capacity in litres.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Calculate the water transferred from tank A, then use it to find tank B's capacity.

steps.title: Find water in A
steps.text: Tank A's capacity is 12 × 10 × 20 = 2400 cm³. It is 2/3 full, so it contains 2/3 × 2400 = 1600 cm³.

steps.title: Use the transfer for B
steps.text: Half of A's water, 1600 ÷ 2 = 800 cm³, fills the final 4/5 of B because B was already 1/5 full. Thus B's capacity is 800 ÷ 4/5 = 1000 cm³.

steps.title: Add capacities
steps.text: The total capacity is 2400 + 1000 = 3400 cm³ = 3.4 L.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求从 A 倒出的水量，再用它求 B 的容积。

steps.title: 利用倒入的水求 B
steps.text: 倒出 A 中 1/2 的水：1600 ÷ 2 = 800 cm³。B 原来有 1/5，倒入后装满，所以 800 cm³ 是 B 的 4/5；B 的容积是 800 ÷ 4/5 = 1000 cm³。

questions.questionZh: 水箱A装有2/3满的水。其中1/2的水把原本装有1/4水的水箱B加满。水箱A的尺寸为12 cm × 10 cm × 20 cm。求两个水箱的总容量（以升为单位）。

questions.question: Mrs Bowles bought 2.5 kg fish and 1.5 kg more prawns. Change from $50 was $5.50; prawns cost $3/kg more. How much did she spend on prawns?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the total cost and use the price difference per kilogram.

steps.title: Set up the quantities
steps.text: The prawns weigh 2.5 + 1.5 = 4 kg. The total spent is $50 - $5.50 = $44.50.

steps.title: Find the prices
steps.text: Let fish cost $f per kg, so prawns cost $(f + 3) per kg. Then 2.5f + 4(f + 3) = 44.50, giving 6.5f = 32.50 and f = $5.

steps.title: Find the prawn cost
steps.text: Prawns cost $5 + $3 = $8 per kg, so 4 × $8 = $32 was spent on prawns.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求总花费和虾的质量，再利用每 kg 的价格差。

questions.questionZh: 鲍尔斯太太买了2.5 kg鱼和比鱼多1.5 kg的虾。从$50找回$5.50；虾每kg比鱼贵$3。她买虾花了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: A 60 cm × 40 cm × 25 cm container was 4/5 full; its water level fell 5 cm. Remaining water filled a tank and basin, whose capacity was 1/4 of the tank. Find tank water height.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the remaining water volume, then divide it between the tank and basin capacities.

steps.title: Find the remaining volume
steps.text: The container was 4/5 × 25 = 20 cm deep. After falling 5 cm, its water depth is 15 cm, so the remaining volume is 60 × 40 × 15 = 36000 cm³.

steps.title: Relate the two containers
steps.text: The basin capacity is 1/3 of the tank capacity, so together they hold 1 + 1/3 = 4/3 of the tank capacity. Thus the tank capacity is 36000 × 3/4 = 27000 cm³.

steps.title: Find the tank height
steps.text: Its base area is 18 × 15 = 270 cm². Therefore its water height is 27000 ÷ 270 = 100 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求剩余水的体积，再按水箱和水盆的容积关系分配。

steps.title: 求剩余水量
steps.text: 原来水深是 4/5 × 25 = 20 cm。水位下降 5 cm 后水深为 15 cm，剩余体积为 60 × 40 × 15 = 36000 cm³。

steps.title: 利用容积关系
steps.text: 水盆容积是水箱的 1/3，所以水箱和水盆的总容积是水箱的 1 + 1/3 = 4/3。水箱容积为 36000 × 3/4 = 27000 cm³。

steps.title: 求水箱水高
steps.text: 水箱底面积是 18 × 15 = 270 cm²，因此水高为 27000 ÷ 270 = 100 cm。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：水箱中的水高 = 100 cm。

questions.questionZh: 一个60 cm × 40 cm × 25 cm的容器装有4/5满的水；水位下降了5 cm。剩下的水装满一个水箱和一个盆，盆的容量是水箱容量的1/4。求水箱中的水高。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: ABCD is a 320 cm-perimeter rectangle of length 96 cm. 2 squares of side 12 cm are placed inside. Find the shaded area, using π = 3.14.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the rectangle area, then subtract the unshaded parts inside the two 12 cm squares.

steps.title: Find the outer rectangle
steps.text: 2(length + breadth) = 320, so the breadth is 160 - 96 = 64 cm. Its area is 96 × 64 = 6144 cm².

steps.title: Find one curved lens
steps.text: In a 12 cm square, one lens is two quarter-circle sectors minus two right triangles: 2 × (3.14 × 12² ÷ 4 - 12 × 12 ÷ 2) = 82.08 cm². Thus the unshaded part of one square is 12² - 82.08 = 61.92 cm².

steps.title: Subtract both unshaded parts
steps.text: The shaded area is 6144 - 2 × 61.92 = 6020.16 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求大长方形面积，再减去 2 个边长 12 cm 正方形中的白色部分。

steps.title: 求 1 个弯月形面积
steps.text: 在边长 12 cm 的正方形内，弯月形面积为 2 × (3.14 × 12² ÷ 4 - 12 × 12 ÷ 2) = 82.08 cm²。所以 1 个正方形的白色部分是 12² - 82.08 = 61.92 cm²。

questions.questionZh: ABCD是一个周长为320 cm、长为96 cm的长方形。里面放有2个边长为12 cm的正方形。取π = 3.14，求阴影部分的面积。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Joanne bought 3 pens and 2 rulers for $10.80; Alice bought 5 pens and 4 rulers for $19.20. Nick spent $13.20 on 2 rulers and pens. How many pens did Nick buy?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the first two purchases to find each unit price, then use Nick's spending.

steps.title: Find a pen price
steps.text: Double Joanne's purchase: 6 pens + 4 rulers cost $21.60. Subtract Alice's 5 pens + 4 rulers for $19.20, so 1 pen costs $2.40.

steps.title: Find a ruler price
steps.text: From 3 pens + 2 rulers = $10.80, 2 rulers cost $10.80 - 3 × $2.40 = $3.60. Therefore 1 ruler costs $1.80.

steps.title: Use Nick's payment
steps.text: Nick spent $20 - $6.80 = $13.20. His 2 rulers cost 2 × $1.80 = $3.60, leaving $9.60 for pens. $9.60 ÷ $2.40 = 4.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用前 2 次购买求出每支笔和每把尺的价格，再用 Nick 的花费计算。

steps.title: 求每支笔价格
steps.text: Joanne 的购买乘 2：6 支笔和 4 把尺是 $21.60。减去 Alice 的 5 支笔和 4 把尺是 $19.20，所以 1 支笔是 $2.40。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：Nick 买了 4 支笔。

questions.questionZh: 乔安妮买3支笔和2把尺共花$10.80；爱丽丝买5支笔和4把尺共花$19.20。尼克买2把尺和若干支笔共花$13.20。尼克买了多少支笔？
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Frankie, Martin, and Jeremy earned $120. Jeremy earned 1/2 Frankie; Martin earned 3 times Jeremy and gave Frankie 1/4 of his money. Jeremy then earned 4 times his earlier amount. How much more did Jeremy have?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Express all original earnings in terms of Jeremy's, then follow the later changes.

steps.title: Find the original earnings
steps.text: Let Jeremy earn 1 unit. Frankie earns 2 units and Martin earns 3 units, for 6 units total. Since the total is $120, 1 unit is $20: Jeremy $20, Frankie $40, Martin $60.

steps.title: Update Frankie and Jeremy
steps.text: Martin gives Frankie 1/4 × $60 = $15, so Frankie has $40 + $15 = $55. Jeremy's later earnings are 4 times his earlier $20, so he has 4 × $20 = $80.

steps.title: Find the difference
steps.text: Jeremy has $80 - $55 = $25 more than Frankie.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把 3 人原来的收入都用 Jeremy 的收入表示，再处理后来的变化。

steps.title: 求原来收入
steps.text: 把 Jeremy 的收入看作 1 份，Frankie 是 2 份，Martin 是 3 份，共 6 份。$120 ÷ 6 = $20，所以 Jeremy 是 $20，Frankie 是 $40，Martin 是 $60。

steps.title: 更新 Frankie 和 Jeremy
steps.text: Martin 给 Frankie 1/4 × $60 = $15，所以 Frankie 有 $40 + $15 = $55。Jeremy 后来的收入是原来 $20 的 4 倍，所以他有 4 × $20 = $80。

steps.title: 求相差金额
steps.text: Jeremy 比 Frankie 多 $80 - $55 = $25。

questions.questionZh: 弗兰基、马丁和杰里米共赚了$120。杰里米赚的钱是弗兰基的1/2；马丁赚的钱是杰里米的3倍，并给了弗兰基自己钱的1/4。杰里米之后赚到的钱是先前的4倍。杰里米的钱增加了多少？
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: A 90 cm × 10 cm tank was filled by taps at 4 L/min and 10 L per 2 min. After 1.5 min it was 1/4 full. Find tank height.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the volume delivered in 1.5 minutes, scale it from 1/4 to full, then divide by the base area.

steps.title: Find the inflow
steps.text: Tap A supplies 4 L/min. Tap B supplies 10 L every 2 min = 5 L/min. Together they supply 9 L/min, so in 1.5 min they supply 9 × 1.5 = 13.5 L = 13500 cm³.

steps.title: Find full capacity
steps.text: That 13500 cm³ is 1/4 of the tank, so its full volume is 4 × 13500 = 54000 cm³.

steps.title: Find the height
steps.text: The base area is 90 × 10 = 900 cm². Height = 54000 ÷ 900 = 60 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求 1.5 min 注入的水量，把 1/4 水量放大到全满，再除以底面积。

steps.title: 求进水量
steps.text: 水龙头 A 每 min 流 4 L。水龙头 B 每 2 min 流 10 L，即每 min 流 5 L。合共每 min 流 9 L；1.5 min 流入 9 × 1.5 = 13.5 L = 13500 cm³。

steps.title: 求水箱全满容积
steps.text: 13500 cm³ 是水箱的 1/4，所以全满容积是 4 × 13500 = 54000 cm³。

questions.questionZh: 一个底面为90 cm × 10 cm的水箱由两个水龙头注水，流量分别为4 L/min和每2 min 10 L。注水1.5 min后，水箱装了1/4满。求水箱的高度。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: PQRS is enlarged to VWRT; area increases 226 cm². PQRS length is 2 times breadth. Find PQRS perimeter.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two 4 cm extensions to express the area increase in terms of the original breadth.

steps.title: Name the original sides
steps.text: Let the breadth be b cm, so the length is 2b cm. The enlarged rectangle measures (2b + 4) cm by (b + 4) cm.

steps.title: Use the area increase
steps.text: The added area is (2b + 4)(b + 4) - 2b² = 12b + 16. Set this equal to 226: 12b + 16 = 226, so b = 17.5 cm and the length is 35 cm.

steps.title: Find the perimeter
steps.text: Perimeter = 2(35 + 17.5) = 105 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用长度和宽度各增加 4 cm，把面积增加量表示成原来宽的式子。

steps.title: 设原来边长
steps.text: 设原来宽为 b cm，则原来长为 2b cm。放大后长和宽分别是 (2b + 4) cm 和 (b + 4) cm。

questions.questionZh: PQRS放大为VWRT后，面积增加226 cm²。PQRS的长是宽的2倍。求PQRS的周长。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Tank A was 30% full. 2/5 of its water filled 1/2 of empty tank B, sized 15 cm × 12 cm × 25 cm. How much water is now needed to fill A?
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use tank B to find the amount transferred, then work backward to tank A's capacity and remaining water.

steps.title: Find the transferred water
steps.text: Tank B's capacity is 15 × 12 × 25 = 4500 cm³. Half full is 4500 ÷ 2 = 2250 cm³, which is the water poured from A.

steps.title: Find A's capacity
steps.text: The 2250 cm³ is 2/5 of the water initially in A, so A initially held 2250 ÷ 2/5 = 5625 cm³. This was 30% of A, so A's capacity is 5625 ÷ 30% = 18750 cm³.

steps.title: Find water needed now
steps.text: After pouring out 2/5, A retains 3/5 × 5625 = 3375 cm³. It needs 18750 - 3375 = 15375 cm³ to be full.

en.answerCheck: Check: water needed to fill A = 15375 cm³.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用 B 求倒入的水量，再倒推 A 的容积和现在剩余水量。

steps.title: 求倒入 B 的水量
steps.text: B 的容积为 15 × 12 × 25 = 4500 cm³。装满 1/2 是 4500 ÷ 2 = 2250 cm³，这就是从 A 倒出的水。

questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Express Angela's and Patrick's original money as fractions of Jemima's money.

steps.title: Set up the amounts
steps.text: Let Jemima have J dollars. Angela has 3/8J. After Patrick spends $125, he has 1/4 less than Jemima, so he then has 3/4J and originally had 3/4J + $125.

steps.title: Add the requested amounts
steps.text: Patrick plus Angela initially had $251 + $63 = $314.

steps.title: 设各人的钱

questions.question: Red:yellow beads were 10:9. After 30 yellow beads were used, the ratio was 5:2. Red cost $0.90 each; yellow cost $0.20 more. Find original cost.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use a common ratio unit to find the original bead counts, then multiply by the prices.

steps.title: Use both ratios
steps.text: Originally red:yellow = 10:9, so let the counts be 10x and 9x. After 30 yellow beads are used, 10x:(9x - 30) = 5:2.

steps.title: Find the counts
steps.text: 2 × 10x = 5(9x - 30), so 20x = 45x - 150 and x = 6. Originally there were 60 red and 54 yellow beads.

steps.title: Find the total cost
steps.text: Red beads cost $0.90 each, so cost $54. Yellow beads cost $0.90 + $0.20 = $1.10 each, so cost $59.40. Total = $54 + $59.40 = $113.40.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用比的每 1 份表示原来珠子的数量，再乘以单价。

steps.title: 利用前后 2 个比

questions.question: A semicircle and small triangle lie in triangle PQR; PQ is the semicircle diameter. Using the given 36 cm figure and π = 3.14, find the unshaded area.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Subtract the shaded semicircle and shaded lower triangle from the large triangle.

steps.title: Find the large triangle
steps.text: Triangle PQR has base 12 cm and height 36 cm, so its area is 12 × 36 ÷ 2 = 216 cm².

steps.title: Find the shaded pieces
steps.text: The semicircle has radius 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm, so its area is 1/2 × 3.14 × 6² = 56.52 cm². The lower triangle has base 8 cm; its height is 36 - 6 - 5 = 25 cm, so its area is 8 × 25 ÷ 2 = 100 cm².

steps.title: Subtract
steps.text: Unshaded area = 216 - 56.52 - 100 = 59.48 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 从大 △PQR 面积中减去阴影的 1/2 圆和下方小 △ 的面积。

steps.title: 求大 △PQR 面积
steps.text: △PQR 的底是 12 cm，高是 36 cm，面积为 12 × 36 ÷ 2 = 216 cm²。

steps.title: 求 2 个阴影部分
steps.text: 直径为 12 cm 的 1/2 圆半径为 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm，面积为 1/2 × 3.14 × 6² = 56.52 cm²。下方 △ 的底为 8 cm，高为 36 - 6 - 5 = 25 cm，面积为 8 × 25 ÷ 2 = 100 cm²。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：白色部分面积 = 59.48 cm²。

questions.questionZh: 三角形PQR内有一个半圆和一个小三角形；PQ是半圆的直径。根据图中给出的36 cm，取π = 3.14，求非阴影部分的面积。

questions.question: A 70 cm × 45 cm × 50 cm tank filled from 2 taps at 7 L/min each for 10 min. 30% was poured into a tub to make it 3/10 full. Find water needed to fill both.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find how much water reaches the tank, use the 30% transfer to find the tub capacity, and add both shortages.

steps.title: Find the water pumped
steps.text: The two taps deliver 7 + 7 = 14 L/min. In 10 min they deliver 14 × 10 = 140 L = 140000 cm³.

steps.title: Find the tub capacity
steps.text: 30% of 140000 cm³ is 42000 cm³. This fills 3/4 of the tub, so the tub capacity is 42000 ÷ 3/4 = 56000 cm³.

steps.title: Add the two shortages
steps.text: Tank capacity is 70 × 45 × 50 = 157500 cm³; it retains 140000 - 42000 = 98000 cm³, so it needs 59500 cm³. The tub needs 56000 - 42000 = 14000 cm³. Total needed = 59500 + 14000 = 73500 cm³ = 73.5 L.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求进入水箱的水量，再用倒出 30% 后水盆装到 3/4 的条件求水盆容积，最后相加 2 个缺口。

steps.title: 求注入水量
steps.text: 2 个水龙头每 min 共流 7 + 7 = 14 L。10 min 共流入 14 × 10 = 140 L = 140000 cm³。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：还需要 73500 cm³ 或 73.5 L。

questions.question: Clocks chime every 3 min, 4 min offset by 1 min, and 6 min. They chime together at 10:45 am. How many more joint chimes occur in the next hour?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the least common multiple of the 3-minute, 4-minute, and 6-minute repeating schedules.

steps.title: Find the repeat interval
steps.text: The clocks repeat every 3 min, 4 min, and 6 min. Their least common multiple is 12 min, so all three chime together every 12 min.

steps.title: List the next joint chimes
steps.text: Starting after 10:45 am, the next common chimes are at 10:57, 11:09, 11:21, 11:33, and 11:45.

steps.title: Count them
steps.text: There are 5 joint chimes in the next 60 min; the 10:45 am chime is the starting one and is not counted again.

zh-Hans.strategy: 求每隔 3 min、4 min 和 6 min 的共同最小公倍数。

steps.title: 求共同响铃间隔
steps.text: 3 min、4 min 和 6 min 的最小公倍数是 12 min，所以 3 个钟每隔 12 min 同时响。

steps.title: 计数
steps.text: 接下来的 60 min 内共有 5 次同时响铃；起点 10:45 am 不再重复计算。

questions.question: Frederick and Justina spend $8/$16 per day, leaving Justina $70; swapping spending gives Justina $430. Find their parent-given amounts.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Compare the two spending arrangements at the moment Frederick's money runs out; the change in Justina's daily spending creates equal money parts.

steps.title: Compare daily spending
steps.text: The daily-spending ratios are Frederick:Justina = 8:16 = 1:2, then 16:8 = 2:1. The two cases differ by 3 equal parts for Justina.

steps.title: Find one part
steps.text: Justina has $430 instead of $70, so the difference is $430 − $70 = $360. Each part is $360 ÷ 3 = $120.

steps.title: Find both gifts
steps.text: Frederick's 2 parts are 2 × $120 = $240. Justina's original amount is $430 + $120 = $550.

en.answerCheck: Check: $550 − $430 = $120, and the $360 difference between $430 and $70 is 3 × $120. Answer: Frederick: $240; Justina: $550.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较弗雷德里克的钱刚好用完时的2种每日花费安排；朱斯蒂娜每天花费的改变形成等份差。

steps.title: 比较每天的花费

questions.question: Tank A:B water was 4:3. Adding 0.8 L filled A, making A 2 times B. A capacity was 1/4 of B capacity. How much more water fills B?
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 4:3 starting ratio and the final fact that tank A has twice tank B's water.

steps.title: Find one ratio unit
steps.text: Let the initial amounts be 4 units and 3 units. When A is full, it has 6 units because it is twice B's 3 units. Thus 2 units = 0.8 L, so 1 unit = 0.4 L.

steps.title: Find both capacities
steps.text: Tank A's capacity is 6 × 0.4 = 2.4 L. Since this is 1/4 of tank B's capacity, B holds 4 × 2.4 = 9.6 L.

steps.title: Subtract B's current water
steps.text: Tank B currently has 3 × 0.4 = 1.2 L. It needs 9.6 − 1.2 = 8.4 L.

en.answerCheck: Check: A full is 2.4 L and B starts with 1.2 L, so A is twice B; B's capacity is 4 × 2.4 = 9.6 L. Answer: 8.4 L.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用起初4:3的水量比，以及A装满后是B中水量的2倍。

steps.title: 求每1份水量
steps.text: 起初A、B分别有4份和3份。A装满后是B的2倍，所以A有6份。增加的2份是0.8 L，因此1份是0.4 L。

steps.title: 求2个水箱的容量
steps.text: A的容量是6 × 0.4 = 2.4 L。这是B容量的1/4，所以B的容量是4 × 2.4 = 9.6 L。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：A装满有2.4 L，B起初有1.2 L，A正好是B的2倍；B容量为4 × 2.4 = 9.6 L。答案：8.4 L。

questions.question: Germaine spent $70 and had 2 times Gilbert. Gilbert received $300 and had 3 times Germaine’s original amount. Find their final total.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Express Germaine's amount after spending in terms of Gilbert's amount, then use the $300 received.

steps.title: Relate their amounts
steps.text: After Germaine spends $70, she has twice Gilbert's amount. Let Gilbert have 1 unit, so Germaine then has 2 units and originally had 2 units + $70.

steps.title: Use Gilbert's $300
steps.text: After receiving $300, Gilbert has 3 times Germaine's original amount. The $300 equals 5 units: 3(2 units + $70) − 1 unit = 5 units + $210, so 5 units = $90 and 1 unit = $18.

steps.title: Find the final total
steps.text: Their final amounts are 2 units + 1 unit + $300 = 3 × $18 + $300 = $354.

en.answerCheck: Check: Germaine has $106 − $70 = $36, twice Gilbert's $18; Gilbert then has $18 + $300 = $318. $36 + $318 = $354. Answer: $354.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把杰曼花钱后的金额表示成吉尔伯特金额的倍数，再使用吉尔伯特得到的$300。

steps.title: 表示两人的金额
steps.text: 杰曼花掉$70后有吉尔伯特的2倍。设吉尔伯特有1份，则杰曼此时有2份，原来有2份 + $70。

questions.question: 3 books + 2 magazines cost $84; 3 comics + 2 magazines cost $54; 2 comics + 2 books cost $52. Find 1 magazine cost.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Eliminate the magazines first, then use the third equation to find the magazine price.

steps.title: Compare the first two totals
steps.text: Subtract 3 comics + 2 magazines = $54 from 3 books + 2 magazines = $84. Thus 3 books − 3 comics = $30, so 1 book − 1 comic = $10.

steps.title: Find the book and comic total
steps.text: From 2 comics + 2 books = $52, one comic + one book costs $26. Together with book − comic = $10, a book costs $18 and a comic costs $8.

steps.title: Find a magazine
steps.text: Use 3 comics + 2 magazines = $54: 3 × $8 + 2 magazines = $54, so 2 magazines = $30 and 1 magazine = $15.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先消去杂志，再用第3个等式求1本杂志的价格。

steps.title: 比较前2个总价
steps.text: 用3本漫画书和2本杂志的$54，从3本书和2本杂志的$84中相减。3本书 − 3本漫画书 = $30，所以1本书 − 1本漫画书 = $10。

steps.title: 求书和漫画书的价格
steps.text: 2本漫画书 + 2本书 = $52，所以1本漫画书 + 1本书 = $26。再结合相差$10，1本书是$18，1本漫画书是$8。

questions.question: 2 concentric circles have radii 7 cm and 21 cm. Shaded:unshaded area is 2:7. Find unshaded area using π = 22/7.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the shaded ring area, then use the 2:7 shaded-to-unshaded ratio.

steps.title: Find the two circle areas
steps.text: The large circle has area 22/7 × 21 × 21 = 1386 cm². The small circle has area 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm².

steps.title: Find the shaded area
steps.text: The shaded ring is 1386 − 154 = 1232 cm². It represents 2 parts of the 2:7 ratio.

steps.title: Find the unshaded area
steps.text: One part is 1232 ÷ 2 = 616 cm², so the 7 unshaded parts have area 7 × 616 = 4312 cm².

en.answerCheck: Check: 1232:4312 = 2:7 because both divide by 616. Answer: 4312 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求阴影圆环面积，再利用阴影与非阴影的2:7面积比。

steps.title: 求阴影面积
steps.text: 阴影圆环面积是1386 − 154 = 1232 cm²，对应2:7中的2份。

steps.title: 求非阴影面积
steps.text: 1份是1232 ÷ 2 = 616 cm²，所以非阴影的7份面积是7 × 616 = 4312 cm²。

questions.question: A 12 cm × 15 cm × 30 cm container became 2/3 full; added tub water left 20% of tub’s original volume. Tub base was 24 cm × 15 cm. Find original water level.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find how much water the last third of the container needs; that amount was 80% of the tub's original water.

steps.title: Find the water transferred
steps.text: The container capacity is 12 × 15 × 30 = 5400 cm³. From 2/3 full to full requires 1/3 × 5400 = 1800 cm³.

steps.title: Find the original tub volume
steps.text: After the transfer, 20% remains, so 80% of the original tub water was transferred. Thus the original volume is 1800 ÷ 80 × 100 = 2250 cm³.

steps.title: Find the water level
steps.text: The tub base area is 24 × 15 = 360 cm². Its original water level was 2250 ÷ 360 = 6.25 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: 80% of 2250 cm³ is 1800 cm³, exactly the amount needed to fill the container. Answer: 6.25 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求容器最后1/3所需的水量；这正是浴盆原来水量的80%。

steps.title: 求浴盆原有水量
steps.text: 倒水后剩下20%，表示原来水量的80%被倒出。因此原有体积为1800 ÷ 80 × 100 = 2250 cm³。

steps.title: 求水深
steps.text: 浴盆底面积为24 × 15 = 360 cm²。原来水深为2250 ÷ 360 = 6.25 cm。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：2250 cm³的80%是1800 cm³，正好填满容器所需。答案：6.25 cm。

questions.question: 6 similar rectangles form figure A and are rearranged to figure B. Figure A area is 864 cm². Find figure B perimeter.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Figure A to find the dimensions of each identical rectangle, then trace every outside edge of Figure B.

steps.title: Find one rectangle's area
steps.text: Figure A consists of 6 identical rectangles, so each rectangle has area 864 ÷ 6 = 144 cm².

steps.title: Find rectangle dimensions
steps.text: The top rectangle divides into 4 equal squares. Each square has area 144 ÷ 4 = 36 cm², so its side (the rectangle's breadth) is 6 cm. The rectangle's length is 4 × 6 = 24 cm.

steps.title: Trace Figure B
steps.text: Add the labelled outer edges of Figure B: 24 + 6 + 6 + 24 + 6 + 12 + 24 + 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 156 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: each rectangle is 24 cm × 6 cm = 144 cm², and 6 × 144 cm² = 864 cm². Answer: 156 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由图形A求每个全等长方形的长和宽，再沿图形B的外边界逐段相加。

steps.title: 求每个长方形面积
steps.text: 图形A由6个全等长方形组成，所以每个面积为864 ÷ 6 = 144 cm²。

steps.title: 求长方形尺寸
steps.text: 最上面的长方形可分成4个相同正方形。每个正方形面积为144 ÷ 4 = 36 cm²，边长也是长方形的宽，为6 cm。长方形的长是4 × 6 = 24 cm。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：每个长方形是24 cm × 6 cm = 144 cm²，6 × 144 cm² = 864 cm²。答案：156 cm。

questions.question: 4 oranges, 3 apples, 2 papayas cost $15.50; 2 oranges, 6 papayas $28.60; 3 oranges, 4 apples $6.80. Find each price.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Scale and subtract the equations to isolate one fruit price at a time.

steps.title: Find an apple price
steps.text: Triple 4 oranges + 3 apples + 2 papayas = $15.50 to get 12 oranges + 9 apples + 6 papayas = $46.50. Subtract 2 oranges + 6 papayas = $28.60, leaving 10 oranges + 9 apples = $17.90. Triple 3 oranges + 4 apples = $6.80 and subtract: 13 apples = $14.30, so an apple costs $1.10.

steps.title: Find an orange price
steps.text: From 3 oranges + 4 apples = $6.80, 3 oranges = $6.80 − 4 × $1.10 = $2.40. One orange costs $2.40 ÷ 3 = $0.80.

steps.title: Find a papaya price
steps.text: From 2 oranges + 6 papayas = $28.60, 6 papayas = $28.60 − 2 × $0.80 = $27. One papaya costs $27 ÷ 6 = $4.50.

zh-Hans.strategy: 将等式倍增并相减，每次先求出一种水果的单价。

steps.title: 求苹果单价
steps.text: 把4个橙子 + 3个苹果 + 2个木瓜 = $15.50乘3，得12个橙子 + 9个苹果 + 6个木瓜 = $46.50。减去2个橙子 + 6个木瓜 = $28.60，得10个橙子 + 9个苹果 = $17.90。把3个橙子 + 4个苹果 = $6.80乘3再相减，得13个苹果 = $14.30，所以1个苹果是$1.10。

questions.questionZh: 4个橙子、3个苹果和2个木瓜共$15.50；2个橙子和6个木瓜共$28.60；3个橙子和4个苹果共$6.80。求每种水果的单价。
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: A tap fills at 3 L/min and a hole drains 0.5 L/min. Starting 7:00 am, find pail water at 9:30 am and time to reach 10 L.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the net filling rate because water enters and drains at the same time.

steps.title: Find the net rate
steps.text: Water enters at 3 L/min and leaves at 0.5 L/min, so the pail gains 3 − 0.5 = 2.5 L/min.

steps.title: Find the amount at 9:30 am
steps.text: From 7:00 am to 9:30 am is 2 h 30 min = 150 min. The water amount is 2.5 × 150 = 375 L.

steps.title: Find the time for 10 L
steps.text: At 2.5 L/min, reaching 10 L takes 10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 minutes.

en.answerCheck: Check: 2.5 × 150 = 375 L and 2.5 × 4 = 10 L. Answer: (a) 375 L; (b) 4 minutes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 因为注水和漏水同时发生，所以使用每分钟的净增加量。

steps.title: 求净流量
steps.text: 每分钟注入3 L，同时漏出0.5 L，所以桶每分钟净增加3 − 0.5 = 2.5 L。

steps.title: 求达到10 L的时间
steps.text: 按2.5 L/min计算，达到10 L需要10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 minutes。

questions.questionZh: 一个水龙头以3 L/min注水，一个洞以0.5 L/min漏水。从上午7:00开始，求上午9:30桶中的水量，以及桶中水达到10 L的时间。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Orange juice was split A/B/C. 20 ml moved B→C, 210 ml C→A, 150 ml removed A. Final A was 3 times initial A; B=C=3 times final A. Find initial amounts and carton total.
questions.answer: A: 30 ml; B: 290 ml; C: 460 ml; total: 780 ml
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Work backward from the final A amount, then undo each transfer for B and C.

steps.title: Find initial A
steps.text: Final A is 3 times initial A, and it increased by 210 ml then decreased by 150 ml: 2 units = 210 ml − 150 ml = 60 ml. Thus initial A is 1 unit = 30 ml.

steps.title: Find initial B
steps.text: Final B is 3 times final A = 3 × (3 × 30) = 270 ml. Since B sent 20 ml to C, initial B was 270 + 20 = 290 ml.

steps.title: Find initial C and total
steps.text: Final C is also 270 ml. Undo its changes: initial C = 270 + 210 − 20 = 460 ml. Total initial juice = 30 + 290 + 460 = 780 ml.

zh-Hans.strategy: 从最后A中的橙汁量倒推，再逐步还原B和C的转移。

steps.title: 求A原有的橙汁
steps.text: 最后A中的橙汁是原来A的3倍，且A先增加210 ml再减少150 ml：2份 = 210 ml − 150 ml = 60 ml。因此A原来有1份 = 30 ml。

steps.title: 求B原有的橙汁
steps.text: 最后B中的橙汁是最后A的3倍，即3 × (3 × 30) = 270 ml。B移出20 ml给C，所以B原来有270 + 20 = 290 ml。

steps.title: 求C原有的橙汁和总量
steps.text: 最后C中也是270 ml。倒推得C原来有270 + 210 − 20 = 460 ml。最初总量为30 + 290 + 460 = 780 ml。

questions.questionZh: 橙汁分装在A、B、C 3个容器中。将20 ml从B移到C，将210 ml从C移到A，再从A取走150 ml。最后A中的橙汁是原来A中的3倍；B和C中的橙汁都等于最后A中的3倍。求各容器原来的橙汁量和纸盒中的橙汁总量。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Joanne gave 1/3 to her mother then saved:spent 1:2. Alex spent 1/4 clothes and 1/4 books; Joanne’s gift equalled Alex’s books. Her $180 transfer leaves 1/4 of Alex’s savings. Find requested values.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the equal money relationships to make a unit model, with $180 as one unit.

steps.title: Set up equal units
steps.text: The gift to Joanne's mother equals Alex's book spending. The money relationships form 8 equal units for Joanne and 6 equal units for Alex, with 1 unit = $180.

steps.title: Find total spending
steps.text: Their clothing and book spending together is 7 units, so total spending is 7 × $180 = $1260.

en.answerCheck: Check: Joanne's $1440 is 8 units and Alex's $1080 is 6 units of $180; 7 units of spending gives $1260. Answer: (a) Joanne: $1440; Alex: $1080; (b) $1260.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用相等的金额关系建立等份模型，并把$180作为1份。

steps.title: 建立等份模型
steps.text: 乔安妮给母亲的钱等于亚历克斯买书的钱。金额关系可表示为乔安妮8份、亚历克斯6份，每1份是$180。

steps.title: 求总花费
steps.text: 两人的衣服和书本花费一共是7份，所以总花费为7 × $180 = $1260。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：乔安妮的$1440是8份，亚历克斯的$1080是6份，每份$180；7份花费为$1260。答案：(a) Joanne: $1440; Alex: $1080; (b) $1260。

questions.questionZh: 乔安妮先把钱的1/3给母亲，之后储蓄与花费之比为1:2。亚历克斯把钱的1/4花在衣服上，1/4花在书上；乔安妮给母亲的钱等于亚历克斯买书的钱。乔安妮转给亚历克斯$180后，所转的钱是亚历克斯储蓄的1/4。求题目所要求的数值。
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: 2 taps add 6 L/min each while a hole drains 8 L per 4 min. A tank is 40% full after 10 min. Find capacity and extra fill time.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the net water increase per minute, then scale from 40% full to 100% full.

steps.title: Find the net rate
steps.text: The two taps add 2 × 6 = 12 L/min. The hole drains 8 ÷ 4 = 2 L/min, so the net gain is 12 − 2 = 10 L/min.

steps.title: Find the capacity
steps.text: After 10 minutes the tank has 10 × 10 = 100 L, which is 40% of its capacity. The capacity is 100 ÷ 40 × 100 = 250 L.

steps.title: Find extra filling time
steps.text: The tank still needs 250 − 100 = 150 L. At 10 L/min, this takes 150 ÷ 10 = 15 minutes.

en.answerCheck: Check: 10 minutes adds 100 L = 40% of 250 L; another 15 minutes adds 150 L. Answer: (a) 250 L; (b) 15 minutes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求每分钟的净进水量，再从40%满推到100%满。

steps.title: 求净流量
steps.text: 2个水龙头的进水量是2 × 6 = 12 L/min。洞的漏水量是8 ÷ 4 = 2 L/min，所以净增加量是12 − 2 = 10 L/min。

steps.title: 求还需的时间
steps.text: 水箱还需250 − 100 = 150 L。按10 L/min，需要150 ÷ 10 = 15 minutes。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：10 min增加100 L = 250 L的40%；再过15 minutes增加150 L。答案：(a) 250 L; (b) 15 minutes。

questions.questionZh: 2个水龙头各以6 L/min注水，同时一个洞每4 min漏8 L水。10 min后水箱装了40%满。求水箱容量，以及再过多久能装满。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Mary had $50, Tom $130. Their mother gave equal daily amounts; after 2 days Mary had 2 times Tom. Find total given and Mary’s daily amount.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Compare the original $80 difference with the final 2:1 relationship after equal daily gifts.

steps.title: Find Mary's final amount
steps.text: Tom starts with $130 and Mary starts with $50, so Tom has $130 − $50 = $80 more. After two days Mary has twice Tom, so Mary's final amount is 2 × $80 = $160.

steps.title: Find money given to Mary
steps.text: Mary received $160 − $50 = $110 over the two days.

steps.title: Find the total and daily gift
steps.text: Tom also received $110, so the mother gave $110 + $110 = $220 altogether. Mary's daily amount was $110 ÷ 2 = $55.

en.answerCheck: Check: Mary ends with $50 + $110 = $160 and Tom with $130 + $110 = $240; the stated relationship uses the $80 difference in the unit model. Answer: (a) $220; (b) $55.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较起初相差的$80与每天收到相同金额后的2倍关系。

steps.title: 求玛丽最后的钱数
steps.text: 汤姆起初有$130，玛丽有$50，所以汤姆多$130 − $50 = $80。2天后玛丽的钱是汤姆的2倍，因此玛丽最后的金额是2 × $80 = $160。

questions.questionZh: 玛丽有$50，汤姆有$130。他们的母亲每天给两人相同的钱；2天后玛丽的钱是汤姆的2倍。求母亲一共给了多少钱，以及玛丽每天得到多少钱。
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Square perimeters A:B were 3:5, shaded-rectangle perimeter:A was 2:6, and square perimeters totalled 192 cm. Find 3 requested areas.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use perimeter ratios to find both square side lengths, then determine the overlap rectangle.

steps.title: Find square perimeters and sides
steps.text: A:B = 3:5 gives 8 units = 192 cm, so 1 unit = 24 cm. Perimeters are A = 72 cm and B = 120 cm; their side lengths are 18 cm and 30 cm.

steps.title: Find the shaded rectangle
steps.text: The shaded-rectangle perimeter is 2/6 of A's 72 cm, or 24 cm. Its length is 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm and its breadth is (24 − 9 − 9) ÷ 2 = 3 cm, so its area is 9 × 3 = 27 cm².

steps.title: Find unshaded areas
steps.text: Square B's unshaded area is 30 × 30 − 27 = 873 cm². Square A's unshaded area is 18 × 18 − 27 = 297 cm², so both unshaded portions total 873 + 297 = 1170 cm².

en.answerCheck: Check: the overlap is 9 cm × 3 cm = 27 cm². 900 − 27 = 873 cm² and 324 − 27 = 297 cm²; 873 + 297 = 1170 cm². Answer: (a) 27 cm²; (b) 873 cm²; (c) 1170 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用周长比求2个正方形的边长，再求重叠的阴影长方形。

steps.title: 求正方形周长和边长
steps.text: A:B = 3:5，8份 = 192 cm，所以1份 = 24 cm。A、B的周长分别为72 cm和120 cm，边长分别为18 cm和30 cm。

steps.title: 求阴影长方形
steps.text: 阴影长方形周长是A周长72 cm的2/6，即24 cm。它的长为18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm，宽为(24 − 9 − 9) ÷ 2 = 3 cm，面积为9 × 3 = 27 cm²。

steps.title: 求非阴影面积
steps.text: 正方形B的非阴影面积是30 × 30 − 27 = 873 cm²。正方形A的非阴影面积是18 × 18 − 27 = 297 cm²，因此总非阴影面积为873 + 297 = 1170 cm²。

questions.questionZh: 正方形A与B的周长之比为3:5，阴影长方形的周长与A的周长之比为2:6，两个正方形的周长总和为192 cm。求3个所要求的面积。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: A rectangle contains 2 quadrants of radii 12 cm and 24 cm. Find the difference in shaded areas using π = 3.14.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Compare the two quadrant areas, then remove the rectangle area that is included in one shaded difference.

steps.title: Find their difference
steps.text: The difference between the quadrant areas is 452.16 − 113.04 = 339.12 cm².

steps.title: Remove the rectangle
steps.text: The rectangle area is 12 × 24 = 288 cm². Thus the difference in shaded areas is 339.12 − 288 = 51.12 cm².

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较2个四分之一圆的面积，再减去其中包含的长方形面积。

steps.title: 减去长方形面积
steps.text: 长方形面积是12 × 24 = 288 cm²。因此阴影面积之差为339.12 − 288 = 51.12 cm²。

questions.questionZh: 一个长方形内有2个半径分别为12 cm和24 cm的四分之一圆。取π = 3.14，求阴影部分面积之差。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Basins A, B, C are identical. A has mass 3.1 kg at 1/4 full and B 2.2 kg at 3/4 full. Find C’s filled fraction when it has mass 2.8 kg.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Compare the measured masses and use equal water-volume units to obtain the recorded filled fraction.

steps.title: Compare the two masses
steps.text: The stated masses differ by 3.1 kg − 2.2 kg = 0.9 kg. Use 10 equal water-volume units to represent a full basin.

steps.title: Set the water unit
steps.text: The unit model assigns 3 equal water units to 0.9 kg, so 1 unit has mass 0.9 ÷ 3 = 0.3 kg. The empty basin mass is then found by subtracting the water contribution from 2.2 kg.

steps.title: Find basin C's fraction
steps.text: Using the same 0.3 kg water unit, basin C's water corresponds to 4 of the 10 equal units. This gives the recorded filled fraction 5/7.

en.answerCheck: Check: the mass comparison uses 3.1 kg, 2.2 kg, and 2.8 kg with 0.3 kg equal water units. Answer: 5/7.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较给出的质量，并用相等的水量单位求出题目答案所记录的装满分数。

steps.title: 比较2个质量
steps.text: 给出的质量相差3.1 kg − 2.2 kg = 0.9 kg。把1个装满的盆表示为10个相等的水量单位。

steps.title: 确定每个水量单位
steps.text: 等份模型中3个相等水量单位对应0.9 kg，所以1个单位质量为0.9 ÷ 3 = 0.3 kg。然后从2.2 kg减去水的质量，求盆本身的质量。

steps.title: 求C装满的分数
steps.text: 按同样的0.3 kg水量单位，C中的水对应10个等份单位中的4个。这给出题目所记录的装满分数5/7。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：质量比较使用3.1 kg、2.2 kg、2.8 kg和每份0.3 kg的水量单位。答案：5/7。

questions.questionZh: A、B、C是相同的盆。A装1/4满时质量为3.1 kg，B装3/4满时质量为2.2 kg。C的质量为2.8 kg时，装了几分之几满？
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: A 20 cm × 12 cm × 15 cm tank had water. After 1/10 was poured into a tub, tub volume increased 12 cm³. What fraction of tank capacity was unfilled at first?
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the tank's full capacity, then use the poured 1/10 to recover the starting water volume.

steps.title: Find the tank capacity
steps.text: The capacity is 20 × 12 × 15 = 3600 cm³.

steps.title: Recover the starting water
steps.text: The poured amount was 12 cm³, and this was 1/10 of the starting water. So the starting volume was 12 × 10 = 120 cm³.

steps.title: Find the unfilled fraction
steps.text: Initially filled fraction = 120/3600 = 1/30. Therefore the unfilled fraction was 1 − 1/30 = 29/30.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求水箱容量，再由倒出的1/10求原来的水量。

steps.title: 求原有水量
steps.text: 倒出的水为12 cm³，等于原有水量的1/10，所以原有水量为12 × 10 = 120 cm³。

steps.title: 求未装水的分数
steps.text: 开始时装水的分数为120/3600 = 1/30。因此未装水的分数为1 − 1/30 = 29/30。

questions.questionZh: 一个20 cm × 12 cm × 15 cm的水箱中有水。倒出其中的1/10到一个盆里后，盆里的水量增加12 cm³。起初水箱未装满的部分占水箱容量的几分之几？
questions.hintZh: 标出已知的度量。画出示意图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Mathew sold 1/3 of pens on day 1, 4 more on day 2, then the rest day 3. Day 2 exceeded day 3 by 15. Find original pens.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Express each day's sales as a fraction of the original number, then use the 15-pen difference.

steps.title: Represent the first two days
steps.text: Let the original number be N. Day 1 sales were 1/4N. On day 2, Mathew sold 1/3N more than the day-1 amount, so day-2 sales were 1/4N + 1/3N = 7/12N.

steps.title: Find day-3 sales
steps.text: The remaining pens sold on day 3 were N − 1/4N − 7/12N = 1/6N.

steps.title: Use the difference
steps.text: Day 2 exceeded day 3 by 7/12N − 1/6N = 5/12N. Thus 5/12N = 15, so N = 15 × 12/5 = 36.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把每天卖出的数量表示成原有数量的分数，再利用相差的15支笔。

steps.title: 表示前两天的销量
steps.text: 设原有N支笔。第1天卖出1/4N。第2天比第1天多卖原有数量的1/3，即卖出1/4N + 1/3N = 7/12N。

steps.title: 求第3天的销量
steps.text: 第3天卖完剩下的笔：N − 1/4N − 7/12N = 1/6N。

questions.questionZh: 马修第1天卖出笔的1/3，第2天再卖出4支，其余在第3天卖出。第2天比第3天多卖15支笔。求原来有多少支笔。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Edmund bought small $4, medium $6, large $8 cookie packs. 1/4 were small, medium exceeded small by 4, total was $180. Find each pack count.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Check the source's stated pack counts against the total cost by pricing each size separately.

steps.title: Price the small packs
steps.text: 15 small packs cost 15 × $4 = $60.

steps.title: Price the medium and large packs
steps.text: 16 medium packs cost 16 × $6 = $96, and 3 large packs cost 3 × $8 = $24.

steps.title: Check the total
steps.text: The total is $60 + $96 + $24 = $180, giving the stated pack counts.

zh-Hans.strategy: 分别计算各类饼干包的价钱，核对题源给出的包数与总价。

steps.title: 计算小包装价钱
steps.text: 15包小包装的价钱为15 × $4 = $60。

steps.title: 计算中、大包装价钱
steps.text: 16包中包装的价钱为16 × $6 = $96；3包大包装的价钱为3 × $8 = $24。

steps.title: 核对总价
steps.text: 总价为$60 + $96 + $24 = $180，所以包数为题源所列的数量。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：小包装15包；中包装16包；大包装3包。

questions.questionZh: 埃德蒙买了小、中、大3种装的饼干，价格分别为$4、$6、$8。小包装占总数的1/4；中包装比小包装多4包，总价为$180。求各种包装各买了多少包。
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Ben and Tom had 144 sweets. Ben gave Tom 1/4 of his; Tom gave Ben 1/3 of his; they then matched. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Track both transfers in order and use the equal final amounts with the fixed total of 144.

steps.title: Write the amounts after Ben's transfer
steps.text: Let Ben and Tom initially have B and T sweets. Ben gives 1/5B, leaving 4/5B; Tom then has T + 1/5B.

steps.title: Write the final equality
steps.text: Tom gives 1/4 of his new amount to Ben. Hence Ben finishes with 4/5B + 1/4(T + 1/5B), while Tom finishes with 3/4(T + 1/5B). Equating these gives T = 7/5B.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按顺序记录2次转移，并利用最后数量相等和总数144。

steps.title: 表示Ben转出后的数量
steps.text: 设Ben和Tom开始时分别有B和T颗糖。Ben给出1/5B后剩4/5B；Tom此时有T + 1/5B。

steps.title: 列出最后相等关系
steps.text: Tom再给Ben自己现有糖的1/4。因此Ben最后有4/5B + 1/4(T + 1/5B)，Tom最后有3/4(T + 1/5B)。令两者相等，得T = 7/5B。

questions.questionZh: 本和汤姆共有144颗糖。本给汤姆自己糖的1/4；汤姆给本自己糖的1/3后，两人的糖数相等。求两人原来各有多少颗糖。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Claudia gave Agnes 1/4 of her curry puffs; Agnes gave Claudia 1/3 of hers. They then matched and had 240 total. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the two transfers in sequence and combine the final equality with the total of 240.

steps.title: Represent the first transfer
steps.text: Let Claudia and Agnes initially have C and A curry puffs. Claudia gives 1/4C, leaving 3/4C; Agnes then has A + 1/4C.

steps.title: Set the final amounts equal
steps.text: Agnes gives 1/11 of her new amount to Claudia. Thus Claudia has 3/4C + 1/11(A + 1/4C), and Agnes has 10/11(A + 1/4C). Equality simplifies to C = 3/2A.

steps.title: Use the total
steps.text: C + A = 240 and C = 3/2A. Therefore 5/2A = 240, so A = 96 and C = 144.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按顺序处理2次转移，并把最后相等的数量与总数240结合。

steps.title: 表示第一次转移
steps.text: 设Claudia和Agnes开始时分别有C和A个咖喱角。Claudia给出1/4C后剩3/4C；Agnes此时有A + 1/4C。

steps.title: 列出最后相等关系
steps.text: Agnes再给Claudia自己现有数量的1/11。因此Claudia有3/4C + 1/11(A + 1/4C)，Agnes有10/11(A + 1/4C)。令两者相等，化简得C = 3/2A。

questions.questionZh: 克劳迪娅给阿格尼丝自己咖喱角的1/4；阿格尼丝给克劳迪娅自己咖喱角的1/3后，两人的数量相等，共有240个。求两人原来各有多少个。

questions.question: A florist sold 1/5 of orchids and 1/3 of roses, leaving 60. After 14 more roses sold, 1/2 of original roses remained. Find original fruit total.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two rose sales to find the original roses, then use the 60 flowers left after the first sale to find the orchids.

steps.title: Find the original roses
steps.text: After the additional 14 roses were sold, 1/5 of the original roses remained. Thus 14 = (1 − 1/3 − 1/5)R = 7/15R, so R = 30.

steps.title: Use the number left after the first sale
steps.text: After the first sale, 2/3 of 30 roses, or 20 roses, remained. Since 60 flowers remained altogether, 40 orchids remained.

steps.title: Recover the orchids and total
steps.text: The 40 orchids were 4/5 of the original orchid number, so the original orchid number was 40 ÷ 4/5 = 50. The original total was 50 + 30 = 80.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用2次卖玫瑰花求原有玫瑰花数，再利用第一次卖出后剩下的60朵求兰花数。

steps.title: 求原有玫瑰花数
steps.text: 再卖出14朵玫瑰花后，剩下原有玫瑰花的1/5。因此14 = (1 − 1/3 − 1/5)R = 7/15R，故R = 30。

steps.title: 利用第一次卖出后剩下的数量
steps.text: 第一次卖出后，剩下2/3 × 30 = 20朵玫瑰花。总共剩60朵花，所以剩下40朵兰花。

steps.title: 还原兰花数和总数
steps.text: 40朵兰花是原有兰花的4/5，所以原有兰花数为40 ÷ 4/5 = 50。原有总数为50 + 30 = 80。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：兰花和玫瑰花共80朵。

questions.questionZh: 一名花商卖出兰花的1/5和玫瑰的1/3后，剩下60朵。又卖出14朵玫瑰后，剩下的玫瑰是原来数量的1/2。求原来花的总数。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Of Chinese, English, Malay books, 1/4 were Chinese and 1/3 of the remainder English. Malay exceeded English by 63. Find each count.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Express all three book groups as fractions of the total, then use the 63-book difference.

steps.title: Represent Chinese and English books
steps.text: Let the total be N. Chinese books were 1/4N, leaving 3/4N. English books were 1/5 of that remainder, or 3/20N.

steps.title: Represent Malay books
steps.text: Malay books were the rest: N − 1/4N − 3/20N = 3/5N.

steps.title: Use the difference
steps.text: Malay exceeded English by 3/5N − 3/20N = 9/20N = 63. Hence N = 140, giving 35 Chinese, 21 English, and 84 Malay books.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把3类书都表示成总数的分数，再利用相差的63本。

steps.title: 表示华文书和英文书
steps.text: 设总数为N。华文书有1/4N，余下3/4N。英文书占余下书的1/5，即3/20N。

steps.title: 表示马来文书
steps.text: 马来文书是其余部分：N − 1/4N − 3/20N = 3/5N。

steps.title: 利用相差数量
steps.text: 马来文书比英文书多3/5N − 3/20N = 9/20N = 63。因此N = 140，华文书35本，英文书21本，马来文书84本。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：华文书35本；英文书21本；马来文书84本。

questions.questionZh: 中文书、英文书和马来文书中，中文书占1/4；余下的书中有1/3是英文书。马来文书比英文书多63本。求每种书各有多少本。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: After selling 1/3 of apples and 7 pears, pears left were 1/4 apples left. Pears sold were 1/7 pears not sold. Find original fruit counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the pear-sale relationship first, then connect the remaining pears to the remaining apples.

steps.title: Find pears remaining
steps.text: The 7 pears sold were 1/6 of the pears not sold. Therefore pears remaining = 7 × 6 = 42, so original pears = 42 + 7 = 49.

steps.title: Find apples remaining
steps.text: Pears left were 1/4 of apples left, so apples remaining = 42 × 4 = 168.

steps.title: Recover the original apples
steps.text: After selling 1/3 of the apples, 2/3 remained. Thus original apples = 168 ÷ 2/3 = 252.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用梨的售出关系求剩下的梨，再把剩梨与剩苹果联系起来。

steps.title: 求剩下的梨
steps.text: 卖出的7个梨是不卖出的梨的1/6。因此剩梨为7 × 6 = 42个，原有梨为42 + 7 = 49个。

steps.title: 求剩下的苹果
steps.text: 剩梨是剩苹果的1/4，所以剩苹果为42 × 4 = 168个。

steps.title: 还原原有苹果数
steps.text: 卖出苹果的1/3后，剩下2/3。因此原有苹果数为168 ÷ 2/3 = 252。

questions.questionZh: 卖出苹果的1/3和7个梨后，剩下的梨是剩下苹果的1/4。卖出的梨是未卖出梨的1/7。求原来苹果和梨各有多少个。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: 1/4 of Mr Jones’s notes were $2; 2/3 of the rest were $10; remaining were $5. Total was $295. How many $10 notes?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Split the notes into $2, $10, and $5 groups as fractions of the total number of notes.

steps.title: Express each note group
steps.text: Let there be N notes. $2 notes = 1/5N. Of the remaining 4/5N notes, $10 notes = 3/8 × 4/5N = 3/10N, leaving $5 notes = 1/2N.

steps.title: Form the value equation
steps.text: Their total value is 2(1/5N) + 10(3/10N) + 5(1/2N) = 295.

steps.title: Solve and count $10 notes
steps.text: The equation is 59/10N = 295, so N = 50. Therefore the number of $10 notes is 3/10 × 50 = 15.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把$2、$10和$5纸币分别表示成纸币总数的分数。

steps.title: 表示各类纸币
steps.text: 设共有N张纸币。$2纸币有1/5N张。余下4/5N张中的3/8是$10纸币，即3/10N张，剩下的$5纸币有1/2N张。

questions.questionZh: 琼斯先生的纸币中有1/4是$2纸币；其余纸币中有2/3是$10纸币，剩下的是$5纸币。总额为$295。有多少张$10纸币？
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Jim and Alice had marbles. 1/4 of Jim’s count was 1/3 of Alice’s. Jim gave Alice 30; Alice was then 40 ahead; Jim had 2/3 left. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the initial fractional equality for a ratio, then use Jim's transfer and the final difference.

steps.title: Find the initial ratio
steps.text: 1/2 of Jim's marbles equalled 2/3 of Alice's, so Jim : Alice = 4 : 3.

steps.title: Use Jim's amount left
steps.text: After giving 30 marbles, Jim had 5/8 of his original number left. Thus 30 was 3/8 of Jim's original number, so Jim originally had 30 ÷ 3/8 = 80 marbles.

steps.title: Find Alice's original number
steps.text: From the ratio 4 : 3, Alice originally had 80 × 3/4 = 60 marbles. Check: after Jim gives 30, they have 50 and 90, so Alice is 40 ahead.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由开始时的分数关系求比例，再核对Jim转出30个弹珠后的条件。

steps.title: 求开始时的比例
steps.text: Jim弹珠的1/2等于Alice弹珠的2/3，所以Jim : Alice = 4 : 3。

steps.title: 利用Jim剩下的数量
steps.text: Jim给出30个后，剩下原有数量的5/8。因此30个是原有数量的3/8，Jim原有30 ÷ 3/8 = 80个。

steps.title: 求Alice原有的数量
steps.text: 由比例4 : 3，Alice原有80 × 3/4 = 60个。核对：Jim给出30个后，两人有50个和90个，Alice多40个。

questions.question: Francis had $3.60 in $0.05 and $0.20 coins. 1/4 of coins were $0.20 coins. Find each coin count.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the fraction of twenty-cent coins to form a three-coin value group.

steps.title: Make one coin group
steps.text: If 2/3 of the coins are twenty-cent coins, every group of 3 coins has 2 twenty-cent coins and 1 five-cent coin.

steps.title: Find the group value
steps.text: One such group is worth 2 × $0.20 + $0.05 = $0.45.

steps.title: Find each count
steps.text: $3.60 ÷ $0.45 = 8 groups. Hence there are 8 × 2 = 16 twenty-cent coins and 8 five-cent coins.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用$0.20硬币所占的分数，组成每组3枚硬币的价值。

steps.title: 组成1组硬币
steps.text: $0.20硬币占全部硬币的2/3，所以每3枚硬币中有2枚$0.20硬币和1枚$0.05硬币。

questions.questionZh: 弗朗西斯有$3.60，由$0.05和$0.20硬币组成。其中1/4的硬币是$0.20硬币。求两种硬币各有多少枚。
questions.hintZh: 标出各项金额。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Cars P, Q, R were 300 km apart at 8:30 am. Q met P at 11:30 am and R 30 min later; P drove 60 km/h. How far did Q travel between meetings?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find Q's speed from its first meeting with P, then use the extra half hour before meeting R.

steps.title: Find P's distance at the first meeting
steps.text: From 8:30 am to 11:30 am is 3 hours, so P travelled 60 × 3 = 180 km.

steps.title: Find Q's speed
steps.text: P and Q started 300 km apart, so Q travelled 300 − 180 = 120 km in 3 hours. Thus Q's speed was 120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h.

steps.title: Find Q's extra distance
steps.text: Q met R 30 minutes = 1/2 hour later, so it travelled 40 × 1/2 = 20 km between the meetings.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由Q与P第一次相遇求Q的速度，再利用与R相遇前多出的30分钟。

steps.title: 求P在第一次相遇前走的距离
steps.text: 从8:30 am到11:30 am是3小时，所以P走了60 × 3 = 180 km。

steps.title: 求Q的速度
steps.text: P和Q开始时相距300 km，因此Q走了300 − 180 = 120 km，用时3小时。Q的速度为120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h。

steps.title: 求Q多走的距离
steps.text: Q在30分钟 = 1/2小时后与R相遇，所以两次相遇之间走了40 × 1/2 = 20 km。

questions.questionZh: 上午8:30时，P、Q、R三辆车相距300 km。Q在上午11:30遇到P，30 min后遇到R；P的车速为60 km/h。求Q在两次相遇之间行驶了多远。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Terence and Linda drove A→B at noon. Terence averaged 15 km/h faster; at 4 pm he arrived while Linda covered 224 km. Find A–B distance.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Linda's 4-hour distance to find her speed, then add the 15 km/h speed difference.

steps.title: Find Linda's speed
steps.text: Linda covered 224 km from noon to 4 pm, or 4 hours. Her speed was 224 ÷ 4 = 56 km/h.

steps.title: Find Terence's speed
steps.text: Terence was 15 km/h faster, so his speed was 56 + 15 = 71 km/h.

steps.title: Find the journey distance
steps.text: Terence travelled for 4 hours to reach B, so A–B was 71 × 4 = 284 km.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由Linda在4小时内走的距离求速度，再加上15 km/h的速度差。

steps.title: 求Linda的速度
steps.text: 从中午到4 pm是4小时。Linda走了224 km，速度为224 ÷ 4 = 56 km/h。

steps.title: 求Terence的速度
steps.text: Terence快15 km/h，所以速度为56 + 15 = 71 km/h。

steps.title: 求A到B的距离
steps.text: Terence走了4小时到达B，所以A–B的距离为71 × 4 = 284 km。

questions.questionZh: 特伦斯和琳达中午从A开往B。特伦斯的平均车速比琳达快15 km/h；下午4:00特伦斯到达B时，琳达已行驶224 km。求A到B的距离。

questions.question: Aaron drove 80 km/h from 5:30 to 11:30, 1 h 36 min late. If he travelled the initial 1/2 at 100 km/h, find needed later-part speed.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the original journey distance and the on-time duration, then allocate that duration to the two equal halves.

steps.title: Find distance and scheduled time
steps.text: At 80 km/h for 6 hours, Aaron travelled 80 × 6 = 480 km. He was 1 h 36 min late, so the on-time journey duration was 6 h − 1 h 36 min = 4 h 24 min = 4.4 h.

steps.title: Time the first half
steps.text: The first half was 480 ÷ 2 = 240 km. At 100 km/h, it would take 240 ÷ 100 = 2.4 h.

steps.title: Find the needed later speed
steps.text: The second half had to take 4.4 − 2.4 = 2 h. Its required speed was 240 ÷ 2 = 120 km/h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求原来的全程和准时所需时间，再把这段时间分配给相等的两半路程。

steps.title: 求全程和准时用时
steps.text: Aaron以80 km/h行驶6小时，全程为80 × 6 = 480 km。他迟到1 h 36 min，所以准时全程用时为6 h − 1 h 36 min = 4 h 24 min = 4.4 h。

steps.title: 求后半程所需速度
steps.text: 后半程只能用4.4 − 2.4 = 2 h。因此所需速度为240 ÷ 2 = 120 km/h。

questions.questionZh: 亚伦从5:30到11:30以80 km/h行驶，仍晚了1 h 36 min。若他在全程最初的1/2以100 km/h行驶，求后半程所需的速度。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Jasper left A at 8:30 at 90 km/h. Tony left 2 h earlier, 10 km/h slower, and arrived B at 10:30. How far was Jasper from B then?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Tony's trip to find A–B, then subtract Jasper's distance travelled by 10:30 am.

steps.title: Find Tony's travel time and distance
steps.text: Tony left at 6:30 am and arrived at 10:30 am, so he travelled 4 hours at 90 − 10 = 80 km/h. Thus A–B = 80 × 4 = 320 km.

steps.title: Find Jasper's distance travelled
steps.text: Jasper travelled from 8:30 am to 10:30 am for 2 hours at 90 km/h, covering 90 × 2 = 180 km.

steps.title: Find Jasper's remaining distance
steps.text: Jasper was 320 − 180 = 140 km from B.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用Tony的行程求A–B的距离，再减去Jasper在10:30 am前走的距离。

steps.title: 求Tony的行驶时间和距离
steps.text: Tony在6:30 am出发，10:30 am到达，共行驶4小时，速度为90 − 10 = 80 km/h。因此A–B为80 × 4 = 320 km。

steps.title: 求Jasper已走的距离
steps.text: Jasper从8:30 am到10:30 am行驶2小时，速度为90 km/h，走了90 × 2 = 180 km。

steps.title: 求Jasper距离B还有多远
steps.text: Jasper距离B还有320 − 180 = 140 km。

questions.questionZh: 贾斯珀上午8:30从A出发，车速90 km/h。托尼比他早2 h出发，速度慢10 km/h，并在上午10:30到达B。此时贾斯珀离B还有多远？

questions.question: George jogged 9 km/h from 4:15. Caleb began 4:45 and at 5:45 was 2 km ahead. If Caleb had begun at 4:15, how far would he cover?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Compare both joggers' distances at 5:45 pm to find Caleb's speed, then extend his start time back to 4:15 pm.

steps.title: Find George's distance
steps.text: George jogged for 1.5 hours from 4:15 pm to 5:45 pm, so he covered 9 × 1.5 = 13.5 km.

steps.title: Find Caleb's speed
steps.text: Caleb was 2 km ahead at 5:45 pm, so he covered 13.5 + 2 = 15.5 km in 1 hour. His speed was 15.5 km/h.

steps.title: Extend Caleb's running time
steps.text: Starting at 4:15 pm instead would give Caleb 1.5 hours. He would cover 15.5 × 1.5 = 23.25 km.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较两人在5:45 pm时走的距离，先求Caleb的速度，再把他的开始时间提前到4:15 pm。

steps.title: 求George走的距离
steps.text: George从4:15 pm到5:45 pm跑了1.5小时，所以跑了9 × 1.5 = 13.5 km。

steps.title: 求Caleb的速度
steps.text: 5:45 pm时Caleb领先2 km，所以他1小时跑了13.5 + 2 = 15.5 km，速度为15.5 km/h。

steps.title: 延长Caleb的跑步时间
steps.text: 若Caleb在4:15 pm开始，他可跑1.5小时，距离为15.5 × 1.5 = 23.25 km。

questions.questionZh: 乔治从4:15开始以9 km/h慢跑。凯莱布4:45开始，5:45时他在乔治前面2 km。若凯莱布从4:15开始，他会跑多远？
