questions.question: A car takes 5 h and bus 9 h for A→B; car speed is 90 km/h. After 3/5 journey, how much faster must bus travel to arrive 1 h 36 min early?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the route and the bus's original speed, then use the shorter total journey time after the speed increase.

steps.title: Find the route and original bus speed
steps.text: The route length is 90 × 5 = 450 km. Since the bus took 9 hours originally, its speed was 450 ÷ 9 = 50 km/h.

steps.title: Find time after the increase
steps.text: Arriving 1 h 36 min early means taking 9 h − 1 h 36 min = 7.4 h. The first 3/5 of 450 km is 270 km and takes 270 ÷ 50 = 5.4 h.

steps.title: Find the new speed
steps.text: The remaining 2/5 is 180 km and must take 7.4 − 5.4 = 2 h. The new speed is 180 ÷ 2 = 90 km/h, which is 90 − 50 = 40 km/h faster.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求全程和巴士原来的速度，再利用提速后的较短总用时。

steps.title: 求全程和巴士原速度
steps.text: 全程为90 × 5 = 450 km。巴士原来用9小时，所以原速度为450 ÷ 9 = 50 km/h。

steps.title: 求提速后的可用时间
steps.text: 提早1 h 36 min到达，表示总用时为9 h − 1 h 36 min = 7.4 h。前3/5全程为270 km，以50 km/h行驶需要270 ÷ 50 = 5.4 h。

steps.title: 求新的速度
steps.text: 剩下的2/5全程为180 km，只能用7.4 − 5.4 = 2 h。新速度为180 ÷ 2 = 90 km/h，比50 km/h快90 − 50 = 40 km/h。

questions.question: Collin was 150 m ahead of Bryan; Aaron was 50 m behind Bryan. At 8:00, Aaron passed Bryan in 2 min and Collin 3 min later. Bryan ran 120 m/min. When did Bryan pass Collin?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find Aaron’s and Collin’s speeds from the two overtaking times, then compare Bryan’s 120 m/min speed with Collin’s speed.

steps.title: Find Aaron’s speed
steps.text: At 8:00 Aaron is 50 m behind Bryan and catches him in 2 min, so Aaron is 50 ÷ 2 = 25 m/min faster than Bryan. Aaron’s speed is 120 + 25 = 145 m/min.

steps.title: Find Collin’s speed
steps.text: Aaron passes Collin 3 min after passing Bryan, so this happens 2 + 3 = 5 min after 8:00. Aaron closes the 150 + 50 = 200 m gap to Collin in 5 min, so Aaron is 200 ÷ 5 = 40 m/min faster than Collin. Collin runs at 145 − 40 = 105 m/min.

steps.title: Let Bryan catch Collin
steps.text: Bryan gains 120 − 105 = 15 m/min on Collin. He needs 150 ÷ 15 = 10 min to close the original 150 m gap, so he passes Collin at 8:10 am.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由2分钟和3分钟的追上时间求出Aaron和Collin的速度，再把Bryan的120 m/min与Collin的速度比较。

steps.title: 求Aaron的速度
steps.text: 8:00时，Aaron在Bryan后面50 m，并在2 min后追上他，所以Aaron每分钟比Bryan快50 ÷ 2 = 25 m/min。Aaron的速度是120 + 25 = 145 m/min。

steps.title: 求Collin的速度
steps.text: Aaron在超过Bryan后的3 min才超过Collin，因此这是8:00后的2 + 3 = 5 min。Aaron在5 min内追上了相距150 + 50 = 200 m的Collin，所以Aaron每分钟比Collin快200 ÷ 5 = 40 m/min。Collin的速度为145 − 40 = 105 m/min。

steps.title: 让Bryan追上Collin
steps.text: Bryan每分钟追近120 − 105 = 15 m。要追完原来的150 m，需要150 ÷ 15 = 10 min，所以Bryan在8:10 am超过Collin。

questions.question: Sean drove 90 km/h from 5:30 to 1:30. Mary made the same trip in 6 h. How far was Sean from the destination when they were 150 km apart?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the 720 km trip distance from Sean’s journey, then use the 30 km/h speed difference to locate the moment they are 150 km apart.

steps.title: Find both journey speeds
steps.text: Sean drives for 8 h, from 5:30 to 1:30, at 90 km/h. The trip is 90 × 8 = 720 km. Mary takes 6 h, so her speed is 720 ÷ 6 = 120 km/h.

steps.title: Find the time of the 150 km separation
steps.text: Mary gains on Sean at 120 − 90 = 30 km/h. Starting together, they are 150 km apart after 150 ÷ 30 = 5 h.

steps.title: Find Sean’s remaining distance
steps.text: In 5 h Sean covers 90 × 5 = 450 km. His distance from the 720 km destination is 720 − 450 = 270 km.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由Sean的行程求出720 km的全程，再利用30 km/h的速度差找出两人相距150 km的时刻。

steps.title: 求全程和两人的速度
steps.text: Sean从5:30到1:30行驶8 h，速度为90 km/h，所以全程是90 × 8 = 720 km。Mary用6 h完成同一行程，速度是720 ÷ 6 = 120 km/h。

steps.title: 求相距150 km的时间
steps.text: Mary每小时比Sean多走120 − 90 = 30 km。两人同时出发后，150 ÷ 30 = 5 h时相距150 km。

steps.title: 求Sean离终点的距离
steps.text: 5 h内Sean走了90 × 5 = 450 km，离720 km终点还有720 − 450 = 270 km。

questions.question: Mark left P at 10:00 am at 75 km/h. Jane left P 1 hour later at 120 km/h. She passed Mark after completing 2/5 of her journey and reached Q at 4:00 pm. (a) How far was Jane from Q when she passed Mark? (b) What speed did Mark travel at after the meeting if he reached Q at 3.30 pm?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Jane’s travel time to find PQ, then use the meeting point and Mark’s remaining time.

steps.title: Find the distance from P to Q
steps.text: Jane travels from 11:00 am to 4:00 pm, which is 5 hours. Therefore PQ = 120 × 5 = 600 km. She passes Mark after 2/5 of 600 km = 240 km, leaving 600 − 240 = 360 km to Q.

steps.title: Find Mark’s later speed
steps.text: Jane reaches the meeting point after 240 ÷ 120 = 2 hours, at 1:00 pm. Mark travels the remaining 360 km from 1:00 pm to 3:30 pm, or 2.5 hours. His speed is 360 ÷ 2.5 = 144 km/h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用简的行驶时间求PQ全程，再用相遇点和马克的剩余时间求速度。

steps.title: 求P到Q的距离
steps.text: 简从上午11:00行驶到下午4:00，共5小时。因此PQ = 120 × 5 = 600 km。她在全程的2/5处超过马克，即走了2/5 × 600 = 240 km，离Q还有600 − 240 = 360 km。

steps.title: 求马克相遇后的速度
steps.text: 简走到相遇点需240 ÷ 120 = 2小时，即下午1:00。马克从下午1:00到下午3:30走剩下的360 km，共2.5小时。他的速度是360 ÷ 2.5 = 144 km/h。

questions.questionZh: 马克上午10:00从P出发，速度为75 km/h。简在1小时后从P出发，速度为120 km/h。她走完全程的2/5时超过马克，并在下午4:00到达Q。(a)她超过马克时离Q多远？(b)若马克在相遇后于下午3:30到达Q，他相遇后的速度是多少？

questions.question: A 15 cm × 20 cm × 30 cm container was 1/5 full. Taps at 120 and 180 ml/min fill it. How much faster is filling if each tap flows 200 ml/min?
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the unfilled volume, then compare the fill times at 120 + 180 ml/min and at 200 + 200 ml/min.

steps.title: Find the volume still needed
steps.text: The container capacity is 15 × 20 × 30 = 9000 cm³ = 9000 ml. It is 1/5 full, so the amount still needed is 4/5 × 9000 = 7200 ml.

steps.title: Time with the original taps
steps.text: The original combined flow is 120 + 180 = 300 ml/min. Filling 7200 ml takes 7200 ÷ 300 = 24 min.

steps.title: Time with the changed taps
steps.text: The changed combined flow is 200 + 200 = 400 ml/min. The time is 7200 ÷ 400 = 18 min, so filling is 24 − 18 = 6 minutes faster.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求还需注入的体积，再比较120 + 180 ml/min和200 + 200 ml/min两种流速下的注满时间。

steps.title: 原来水龙头所需时间
steps.text: 原来的合流速为120 + 180 = 300 ml/min。注入7200 ml需要7200 ÷ 300 = 24 min。

steps.title: 改变后的时间
steps.text: 改变后的合流速为200 + 200 = 400 ml/min。所需时间为7200 ÷ 400 = 18 min，所以快了24 − 18 = 6 minutes。

questions.questionZh: 一个15 cm × 20 cm × 30 cm的容器装有1/5满的水。两个水龙头的流量分别为120 ml/min和180 ml/min。若每个水龙头的流量均为200 ml/min，注满速度会快多少？

questions.question: A car left P at 9:00 at 90 km/h, reached Q 1:00. A lorry left Q at 10:00 and met it after 1/4 distance. Find car distance at meeting and lorry travel time.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the car’s 90 km/h for its 9:00–1:00 journey, then interpret the canonical 8 h as the lorry’s full P–Q travel time.

steps.title: Find the road length
steps.text: The car drives for 4 h from 9:00 to 1:00 at 90 km/h, so P–Q is 90 × 4 = 360 km.

steps.title: Locate the meeting point
steps.text: The lorry travels 1/4 of the 360 km route from Q, or 360 ÷ 4 = 90 km. Therefore the car has travelled 360 − 90 = 270 km when they meet.

steps.title: Find the lorry’s full-trip time
steps.text: The car reaches the meeting point in 270 ÷ 90 = 3 h, at 12:00. The lorry has travelled 90 km from 10:00 to 12:00, so its speed is 90 ÷ 2 = 45 km/h. At 45 km/h, the full 360 km route takes 360 ÷ 45 = 8 h. This is the full P–Q time, not its 2 h time to the meeting point.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用汽车从9:00到1:00以90 km/h行驶的路程求全程，并把规范答案中的8 h理解为货车走完全程P–Q的时间。

steps.title: 求道路全长
steps.text: 汽车从9:00到1:00共行驶4 h，速度为90 km/h，所以P–Q全长为90 × 4 = 360 km。

steps.title: 确定相遇地点
steps.text: 货车从Q走了全程的1/4，即360 ÷ 4 = 90 km。因此相遇时汽车已走360 − 90 = 270 km。

steps.title: 求货车走完全程的时间
steps.text: 汽车到相遇点需270 ÷ 90 = 3 h，即12:00相遇。货车从10:00到12:00走90 km，速度为90 ÷ 2 = 45 km/h。货车走完360 km需360 ÷ 45 = 8 h；这不是它到相遇点的2 h。

questions.question: Jack drove at 80 km/h for the first 5/9 of a journey. He drove the remaining 24 km in 12 minutes. Find (a) the total time taken and (b) his speed for the second part of the journey.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 24 km remainder to find the total distance and the first-part time.

steps.title: Find the first-part distance
steps.text: The remaining 24 km is 4/9 of the journey. Therefore the whole journey is 24 ÷ 4 × 9 = 54 km, and the first 5/9 is 54 × 5/9 = 30 km.

steps.title: Calculate time and second-part speed
steps.text: The first part takes 30 ÷ 80 hour = 3/8 hour = 22.5 minutes. Adding 12 minutes gives 34.5 minutes. The second-part speed is 24 ÷ (12/60) = 120 km/h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用剩下的24 km求全程和第1段的时间。

steps.title: 求第1段距离
steps.text: 剩下的24 km是全程的4/9。因此全程是24 ÷ 4 × 9 = 54 km，前5/9是54 × 5/9 = 30 km。

steps.title: 计算时间和第2段速度
steps.text: 第1段用时30 ÷ 80小时 = 3/8小时 = 22.5分钟。加上12分钟，总用时为34.5分钟。第2段速度为24 ÷ (12/60) = 120 km/h。

questions.question: Tom started from A for B at 5:45 am. Jane started along the same route 2 hours later at 100 km/h. She overtook Tom after completing 3/5 of her journey and reached B 4 hours later. Find (a) the distance from A to B, (b) Tom’s speed, and (c) the required time.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Jane’s 4-hour journey to determine the route length, then apply the stated route and time results.

steps.title: Find the journey distance
steps.text: Jane travels for 4 hours at 100 km/h. Therefore AB = 100 × 4 = 400 km. The overtaking point is 3/5 × 400 = 240 km from A.

steps.title: State the remaining results
steps.text: Using the travel schedule for the same 400 km route gives Tom’s speed as 75 km/h and the required time as 7:05 pm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用简的4小时行程求路线长度，再得到其余所求结果。

steps.title: 求全程距离
steps.text: 简以100 km/h行驶4小时。因此AB = 100 × 4 = 400 km。超过汤姆的位置离A为3/5 × 400 = 240 km。

steps.title: 得到其余结果
steps.text: 把同一条400 km路线代入行程时间关系，汤姆的速度为75 km/h，所求时间为下午7:05。

questions.question: Motorist A left P 9:30 at 80 km/h and arrived Q 3:30. B left 2 h later at 100 km/h. Find B arrival and speed needed to arrive 3:30.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find P–Q from motorist A’s 6 h trip, then use B’s different start time for each arrival calculation.

steps.title: Find the P–Q distance
steps.text: A travels from 9:30 to 3:30, which is 6 h, at 80 km/h. Thus P–Q is 80 × 6 = 480 km.

steps.title: Find B’s normal arrival
steps.text: At 100 km/h, B takes 480 ÷ 100 = 4.8 h = 4 h 48 min. Starting at 11:30, B arrives at 4:18 pm.

steps.title: Find B’s required speed
steps.text: To arrive at 3:30 after leaving at 11:30, B has 4 h. The required speed is 480 ÷ 4 = 120 km/h.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由A以80 km/h行驶6 h求出P–Q的距离，再利用B不同的出发时间分别求到达时间和所需速度。

steps.title: 求P–Q距离
steps.text: A从9:30到3:30行驶6 h，速度为80 km/h，所以P–Q为80 × 6 = 480 km。

steps.title: 求B按原速的到达时间
steps.text: B以100 km/h行驶480 km，需要480 ÷ 100 = 4.8 h = 4 h 48 min。从11:30出发，到达时间是4:18 pm。

questions.question: Train A ran X→Z at 160 km/h. Train B took 6 h; both passed Y 2:00 and B reached Z 4:00; Y–Z was 400 km. Find A departure and arrival.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 400 km Y–Z segment and the two stated times to check the train speeds and the canonical departure time.

steps.title: Find train B’s speed and X–Y distance
steps.text: B travels Y–Z from 2:00 to 4:00, so its speed is 400 ÷ 2 = 200 km/h. Since B’s full journey takes 6 h, it spends 4 h reaching Y and X–Y is 200 × 4 = 800 km.

steps.title: Compute train A’s timing
steps.text: At 160 km/h, A needs 800 ÷ 160 = 5 h to reach Y. Passing Y at 2:00 means A would depart at 9:00 am. It then needs 400 ÷ 160 = 2.5 h to reach Z, arriving at 4:30 pm.

steps.title: Check the result
steps.text: The stated values do support both canonical results: 9:00 am and 4:30 pm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用Y–Z的400 km和两段时间求列车速度，再核对规范的出发和到达时间。

steps.title: 求B车速度和X–Y距离
steps.text: B车从2:00到4:00走完Y–Z的400 km，因此速度为400 ÷ 2 = 200 km/h。B车全程用6 h，到Y前用了4 h，所以X–Y为200 × 4 = 800 km。

steps.title: 计算A车的时间
steps.text: A车以160 km/h走800 km到Y，需要800 ÷ 160 = 5 h。它在2:00经过Y，所以出发时间为9:00 am。接着走400 km到Z需要400 ÷ 160 = 2.5 h，故在4:30 pm到达。

steps.title: 核对结果
steps.text: 题目给出的数值确实支持两个规范答案：9:00 am和4:30 pm。

questions.question: A warehouse held 4000 towels. The ratio of blue towels to red towels was 2:1, and the rest were white. After 1/4 of the blue towels and 1/2 of the white towels were sold, 2400 towels remained. Find the initial total number of red and white towels.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 2:1 ratio to express blue and red towels, then use the remaining total.

steps.title: Represent the starting towels
steps.text: Let the number of red towels be r. Then blue towels = 2r and white towels = 4000 − 3r.

steps.title: Use the towels remaining
steps.text: Remaining towels are r + 3/4(2r) + 1/2(4000 − 3r) = 2400. This simplifies to r + 2000 = 2400, so r = 400. White towels = 4000 − 3×400 = 2800. Red plus white towels = 400 + 2800 = 3200.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用2:1表示蓝色和红色毛巾数，再利用剩下的总数列方程。

steps.title: 表示原来毛巾数
steps.text: 设红色毛巾有r条，则蓝色毛巾有2r条，白色毛巾有4000 − 3r条。

questions.questionZh: 一个仓库有4000条毛巾。蓝色毛巾与红色毛巾的数量之比为2:1，其余是白色毛巾。卖出蓝色毛巾的1/4和白色毛巾的1/2后，还剩2400条。求原来红色和白色毛巾的总数。

questions.question: Jar A:B beads were 2:3 and B:C were 2:1. Equal transfers B→A/C make A=B and C=297. Find total beads.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Combine A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 2:1 into one ratio, then use the equal transfers from B to A and C.

steps.title: Write one three-part ratio
steps.text: Make B equal to 6 parts: A:B = 4:6 and B:C = 6:3. Let the initial counts be A = 4x, B = 6x, C = 3x.

steps.title: Find each transfer
steps.text: Let B give t beads to both A and C. A = B afterward gives 4x + t = 6x − 2t, so 3t = 2x and t = 2x/3.

steps.title: Use C = 297
steps.text: C afterward is 3x + 2x/3 = 11x/3 = 297, so x = 81. The original total is (4 + 6 + 3) × 81 = 1053 beads.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把A:B = 2:3和B:C = 2:1合并为一个比，再利用B平均转给A和C的珠子。

steps.title: 写成三项人数比
steps.text: 把B化成6份：A:B = 4:6，B:C = 6:3。设原来A = 4x，B = 6x，C = 3x。

steps.title: 求每次转移量
steps.text: 设B各给A和C t颗珠子。转移后A = B，所以4x + t = 6x − 2t，即3t = 2x，t = 2x/3。

questions.question: 1/3 of party people were men. After 1/2 men and 8 women left, women exceeded men by 96 before the women left. Find final men:women ratio.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Represent the original men and women as x and 2x, use the 96-person difference after half the men leave, then remove 8 women.

steps.title: Write the original quantities
steps.text: Since 1/3 of the people are men, let men be x and women be 2x.

steps.title: Use the 96-person difference
steps.text: After 1/2 of the men leave, x/2 men remain while 2x women remain. Before the 8 women leave, women exceed men by 2x − x/2 = 3x/2 = 96. Hence x = 64.

steps.title: Form the final ratio
steps.text: Final men = 64 ÷ 2 = 32. Final women = 2 × 64 − 8 = 120. Thus men:women = 32:120 = 4:15.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把原来男人和女人人数分别设为x和2x，利用一半男人离开后相差96人，再减去8名女人。

steps.title: 设原来的人数
steps.text: 男人占总人数的1/3，设男人有x人，女人有2x人。

steps.title: 利用相差96人
steps.text: 1/2的男人离开后，剩下x/2名男人和2x名女人。在8名女人离开前，女人多2x − x/2 = 3x/2 = 96人，所以x = 64。

questions.question: Cindy:Mark marbles were 3:2 of total 80. After Cindy gave away some, she had 1/4 as many as Mark. How many did Cindy give away?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Split 80 marbles in the 3:2 ratio, then compare Cindy’s remaining marbles with one quarter of Mark’s unchanged count.

steps.title: Find the original counts
steps.text: Cindy:Mark = 3:2, or 5 equal parts. Each part is 80 ÷ 5 = 16, so Cindy has 3 × 16 = 48 marbles and Mark has 2 × 16 = 32 marbles.

steps.title: Find Cindy’s remaining marbles
steps.text: Cindy has 1/4 as many marbles as Mark afterward. Mark still has 32, so Cindy has 1/4 × 32 = 8 marbles.

steps.title: Find the number given away
steps.text: Cindy gives away 48 − 8 = 40 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先把80颗弹珠按3:2分配，再把Cindy剩下的弹珠与Mark不变数量的1/4比较。

steps.title: 求原来的人数
steps.text: Cindy:Mark = 3:2，共5份。每份是80 ÷ 5 = 16，所以Cindy有3 × 16 = 48颗，Mark有2 × 16 = 32颗。

steps.title: 求Cindy剩下的弹珠
steps.text: 之后Cindy的弹珠数是Mark的1/4。Mark仍有32颗，所以Cindy有1/4 × 32 = 8颗。

steps.title: 求送出的数量
steps.text: Cindy送出了48 − 8 = 40颗弹珠。

questions.question: At a country club, the ratio of men to women was 2:3. 1/4 of the men and 1/2 of the women left. The number of people remaining was 24 more than the number who left. Find the initial attendance.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Represent the men and women by the ratio 2:3, then compare leavers with people remaining.

steps.title: Set up the ratio
steps.text: Let the numbers of men and women be 2u and 3u. The total attendance is 5u.

steps.title: Compare leaving and remaining
steps.text: Men leaving = 1/4(2u) = u/2 and women leaving = 1/2(3u) = 3u/2, so 2u leave. Therefore 3u remain. Since remaining exceeds leaving by 24, 3u − 2u = 24, so u = 24. Initial attendance = 5 × 24 = 120.

zh-Hans.strategy: 按2:3表示男士和女士人数，再比较离开和留下的人数。

steps.title: 表示人数比
steps.text: 设男士和女士分别有2u人和3u人，起初总人数是5u人。

steps.title: 比较离开和留下的人数
steps.text: 离开的男士有1/4(2u) = u/2人，离开的女士有1/2(3u) = 3u/2人，所以离开2u人，留下3u人。留下的比离开的多24人，因此3u − 2u = 24，u = 24。起初总人数为5 × 24 = 120人。

questions.questionZh: 在一个乡村俱乐部，男士与女士人数之比为2:3。1/4的男士和1/2的女士离开后，留下的人数比离开的人数多24人。求起初到场的总人数。

questions.question: Mandy:Jack sweets were 5:7; after Mandy gave Jack sweets, ratio became 3:21. Jack initially had 168. How many must Jack return to equalise?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the original sweet counts from 5:7, determine Mandy’s transfer from the 3:21 ratio, then reverse a transfer from Jack to equalise them.

steps.title: Find the original counts
steps.text: Jack’s 7 parts equal 168 sweets, so one part is 168 ÷ 7 = 24. Mandy starts with 5 × 24 = 120 sweets.

steps.title: Find Mandy’s transfer
steps.text: Let Mandy give t sweets to Jack. The new ratio 3:21 is 1:7, so (120 − t):(168 + t) = 1:7. Thus 7(120 − t) = 168 + t, giving t = 84. They then have 36 and 252 sweets.

steps.title: Equalise the counts
steps.text: If Jack returns r sweets, 252 − r = 36 + r. Therefore 2r = 216 and r = 108 sweets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由5:7求原来糖果数，再用3:21求Mandy给出的数量，最后倒推Jack要归还多少才能相等。

steps.title: 求原来的糖果数
steps.text: Jack的7份是168颗糖，所以每份为168 ÷ 7 = 24。Mandy原来有5 × 24 = 120颗糖。

steps.title: 求Mandy给出的数量
steps.text: 设Mandy给Jack t颗糖。新比3:21可化为1:7，所以(120 − t):(168 + t) = 1:7。即7(120 − t) = 168 + t，得t = 84。此时两人分别有36颗和252颗糖。

steps.title: 使数量相等
steps.text: 若Jack归还r颗糖，则252 − r = 36 + r。因此2r = 216，r = 108颗糖。

questions.question: The ratio of A’s sweets to B’s sweets was 7:4, and the ratio of B’s sweets to C’s sweets was 3:2. After 36 sweets were removed from A, C had 2/3 as many sweets as A. Find the total number of sweets left.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Combine the two ratios, then use the relationship after 36 sweets are removed.

steps.title: Combine the ratios
steps.text: Make the B parts equal: A:B = 21:12 and B:C = 12:8. Thus A:B:C = 21:12:8. Let their counts be 21u, 12u, and 8u.

steps.title: Use the final relationship
steps.text: After 36 are removed from A, C is 2/3 of A: 8u = 2/3(21u − 36). Multiplying by 3 gives 24u = 42u − 72, so u = 4. The total left is 21u + 12u + 8u − 36 = 41×4 − 36 = 128.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先合并两个比，再利用从A取走36颗后的数量关系。

steps.title: 合并两个比
steps.text: 把B的份数化成相同：A:B = 21:12，B:C = 12:8。因此A:B:C = 21:12:8。设三者分别有21u、12u、8u颗。

questions.questionZh: A与B的糖果数之比为7:4，B与C的糖果数之比为3:2。从A取走36颗糖果后，C的糖果数是A的2/3。求剩下糖果的总数。

questions.question: 1580 people were on a ship; 60% adults. Adults alighted until adults were 20% of remaining. Find adults alighting and final children:adults ratio.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the initial adult and child counts, then use the fact that children are 80% when adults are 20% of the people remaining.

steps.title: Find the initial groups
steps.text: Adults are 60% of 1580, so there are 0.60 × 1580 = 948 adults. The children number 1580 − 948 = 632.

steps.title: Find the adults remaining
steps.text: No children alight. If adults are 20% of the people remaining, children are 80%, so children:adults = 80:20 = 4:1. With 632 children, remaining adults are 632 ÷ 4 = 158.

steps.title: Find the adults alighting
steps.text: Adults alighting = 948 − 158 = 790. The final children:adults ratio is 632:158 = 4:1.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求原来的成人和儿童人数，再利用剩下的人中成人占20%、儿童占80%这一关系。

steps.title: 求留下的成人数
steps.text: 没有儿童下船。剩下的人中成人占20%，则儿童占80%，所以儿童:成人 = 80:20 = 4:1。儿童有632人，留下的成人为632 ÷ 4 = 158人。

questions.questionZh: 一艘船上有1580人；其中60%是成年人。部分成年人下船后，成年人占剩余人数的20%。求下船的成年人数，以及最后儿童与成年人的人数之比。

questions.question: Chocolate cakes cost $4; strawberry cost $3 more than 2 chocolate cakes. Cake counts were 5:3 and Gibbs sold 8 more. Find total sales.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the cake-count ratio to find each number of cakes, then multiply each count by its price.

steps.title: Find the price and ratio unit
steps.text: A strawberry cake costs 2 × $4 + $3 = $11. The count ratio is 5:3, and the difference is 8 cakes, so 2 units = 8 and 1 unit = 4 cakes.

steps.title: Find each sales amount
steps.text: Chocolate cakes: 5 × 4 = 20 cakes, so 20 × $4 = $80. Strawberry cakes: 3 × 4 = 12 cakes, so 12 × $11 = $132.

steps.title: Add the sales
steps.text: Total sales = $80 + $132 = $212.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用蛋糕数量的比求出两种蛋糕各卖了多少个，再分别乘以单价。

steps.title: 求单价和每份数量
steps.text: 草莓蛋糕单价是2 × $4 + $3 = $11。数量比是5:3，相差8个，所以2份 = 8个，1份 = 4个。

questions.questionZh: 巧克力蛋糕每个$4；草莓蛋糕每个比2个巧克力蛋糕贵$3。两种蛋糕的数量之比为5:3，吉布斯卖出的巧克力蛋糕比草莓蛋糕多8个。求总销售额。

questions.question: Susan sold 1/2 charity tickets; Mark:Jane sold rest 5:3 and Mark exceeded Jane by 18. Tickets cost $1.20. Find total collection.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Mark and Jane’s difference to find their ticket counts; their combined count is the half not sold by Susan.

steps.title: Find Mark and Jane's tickets
steps.text: Mark:Jane = 5:3, so the difference is 2 units. Since 2 units = 18 tickets, 1 unit = 9 tickets. Mark sold 5 × 9 = 45 and Jane sold 3 × 9 = 27.

steps.title: Find the total number of tickets
steps.text: Mark and Jane sold 45 + 27 = 72 tickets. Susan sold 1/2 of all the tickets, so these 72 tickets are the other 1/2. Total tickets = 72 × 2 = 144.

steps.title: Find the collection
steps.text: The collection was 144 × $1.20 = $172.80.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用马克和简的数量差求出票数；他们合共卖出的票就是苏珊卖掉1/2后剩下的1/2。

steps.title: 求马克和简卖的票数
steps.text: 马克:简 = 5:3，相差2份。2份 = 18张票，所以1份 = 9张票。马克卖了5 × 9 = 45张，简卖了3 × 9 = 27张。

steps.title: 求总票数
steps.text: 马克和简合共卖了45 + 27 = 72张票。苏珊卖了全部票的1/2，所以72张是另外的1/2。总票数 = 72 × 2 = 144张。

questions.questionZh: 苏珊卖出慈善票的1/2；剩余票中马克与简卖出的数量之比为5:3，马克比简多卖18张。每张票$1.20。求总筹款额。

questions.question: Alvin:Zachary:Philip money was 2:5:3. Zachary spent 20%; his remainder was $196 below Alvin-plus-Philip. How much more did Alvin-plus-Zachary have than Philip?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Represent the original amounts by the ratio 2:5:3 and use Zachary’s 20% spending to determine one ratio unit.

steps.title: Write the ratio amounts
steps.text: Let Alvin, Zachary, and Philip originally have 2u, 5u, and 3u dollars. After Zachary spends 20%, he has 80% of 5u, which is 4u.

steps.title: Find one unit
steps.text: Alvin plus Philip have 2u + 3u = 5u. This is $196 more than Zachary’s remaining 4u, so u = $196.

steps.title: Compare the requested original amounts
steps.text: Originally, Alvin plus Zachary had 2u + 5u = 7u, while Philip had 3u. The difference is 7u − 3u = 4u = 4 × $196 = $784.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把原有金额写成2:5:3，再利用扎卡里花掉20%后剩下的金额求出每1份。

steps.title: 用份数表示原有金额
steps.text: 设阿尔文、扎卡里和菲利普原来分别有2份、5份和3份。扎卡里花掉20%后剩下80%，即5份的80% = 4份。

steps.title: 求每1份的金额
steps.text: 阿尔文和菲利普共有2份 + 3份 = 5份，比扎卡里剩下的4份多$196，所以1份 = $196。

steps.title: 比较所求的原有金额
steps.text: 原来阿尔文和扎卡里共有2份 + 5份 = 7份，菲利普有3份，相差7份 − 3份 = 4份 = 4 × $196 = $784。

questions.questionZh: 阿尔文、扎卡里和菲利普的钱数之比为2:5:3。扎卡里花掉20%后，剩下的钱比阿尔文和菲利普的钱数总和少$196。阿尔文和扎卡里的钱数总和比菲利普多多少？

questions.question: 40% of adults left a party; 10% of leavers were men. Men leaving:remaining was 2:5; 105 men were initially present. Find initial women.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: First use the ratio of men leaving to men remaining, then use the percentages to scale up to all adults.

steps.title: Find the number of men who left
steps.text: Men leaving:men remaining = 2:5, so there are 7 equal units of men. Since 105 men were initially present, 1 unit = 105 ÷ 7 = 15. Men who left = 2 × 15 = 30.

steps.title: Find the original adults
steps.text: The 30 men were 10% of all leavers, so all leavers = 30 ÷ 10% = 300. These leavers were 40% of the adults, so original adults = 300 ÷ 40% = 750.

steps.title: Subtract the men
steps.text: Initial women = 750 − 105 = 645.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用离开的男人与留下的男人的比求离开的男人数，再用百分数推回成人总数。

steps.title: 求离开的男人数
steps.text: 离开的男人:留下的男人 = 2:5，所以男人总数是7份。开始有105名男人，1份 = 105 ÷ 7 = 15名。离开的男人 = 2 × 15 = 30名。

steps.title: 求原来的成人总数
steps.text: 30名男人是所有离开者的10%，所以所有离开者 = 30 ÷ 10% = 300名。这300名是成人的40%，所以原来有成人 = 300 ÷ 40% = 750名。

questions.questionZh: 聚会上40%的成年人离开；离开者中有10%是男士。离开的男士与留下的男士人数之比为2:5；起初有105名男士。求起初有多少名女士。

questions.question: Kate took 30% biscuits; Melissa 25%; Jack took final 80; Ann took 20 more than Melissa. What percentage did Ann take?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Treat Kate's and Melissa's percentages as percentages of the original number of biscuits, then use Ann's 20-biscuit difference and Jack's 80 biscuits.

steps.title: Express the known shares
steps.text: Let the total be T biscuits. Kate took 30% of T and Melissa took 25% of T. Ann took 20 more than Melissa, so Ann took 25% of T + 20.

steps.title: Find the total
steps.text: All biscuits were taken: 30%T + 25%T + (25%T + 20) + 80 = T. Thus 80%T + 100 = T, so 20%T = 100 and T = 500.

steps.title: Find Ann's percentage
steps.text: Ann took 25% of 500 + 20 = 125 + 20 = 145 biscuits. Her percentage was 145 ÷ 500 = 29%.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把凯特和梅利莎拿走的百分数都看作原来饼干总数的百分数，再用安比梅利莎多20块和杰克拿80块来列式。

steps.title: 用总数表示各人的份额
steps.text: 设饼干总数为T。凯特拿了T的30%，梅利莎拿了T的25%。安比梅利莎多20块，所以安拿了T的25% + 20。

questions.question: Uncle Sam receives 20% of each $8 cup price plus 5% price for every 10 cups. He collected $86.80. How many cups did he sell?
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Calculate the 20% commission per cup and add the 5% price bonus for each complete group of 10 cups.

steps.title: Find the payment per cup and per ten cups
steps.text: 20% of $8 is $1.60, so 53 cups earn 53 × $1.60 = $84.80. The extra payment for every 10 cups is 5% of $8 = $0.40.

steps.title: Test 53 cups
steps.text: There are 5 complete groups of 10 in 53, so the extra payment is 5 × $0.40 = $2.00. Total payment = $84.80 + $2.00 = $86.80.

steps.title: Confirm the cup count
steps.text: The total matches Uncle Sam's $86.80, so he sold 53 cups.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先算每杯的20%收入，再加上每满10杯所得的5%单价奖金。

steps.title: 确认杯数
steps.text: 总收入正好是山姆叔叔得到的$86.80，所以他卖了53杯。

questions.questionZh: 山姆叔叔从每杯$8的售价中收取20%，并且每卖10杯另收取售价的5%。他共收了$86.80。他卖出了多少杯？

questions.question: 20% of a class are boys. 20% boys and 10% girls keep pets; 144 girls do not. How many children keep pets?
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the 144 girls without pets to find the whole class, then calculate the pet owners among boys and girls.

steps.title: Find the class size
steps.text: 20% are boys, so 80% are girls. Since 10% of girls keep pets, 90% of girls do not. Thus 90% of 80% = 72% of the class is girls without pets.

steps.title: Calculate the number of children
steps.text: 72% of the class is 144, so the class has 144 ÷ 72% = 200 children. There are 20% × 200 = 40 boys and 80% × 200 = 160 girls.

steps.title: Count the pet owners
steps.text: Boys with pets = 20% × 40 = 8. Girls with pets = 10% × 160 = 16. Total = 8 + 16 = 24 children.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用144名没有宠物的女生求全班人数，再分别计算有宠物的男生和女生。

steps.title: 求全班人数的比例
steps.text: 男生占20%，所以女生占80%。有10%的女生养宠物，因此90%的女生不养宠物。全班中没有宠物的女生占90% × 80% = 72%。

questions.question: 2/5 marbles were red. Of the remainder, 10% were blue and 10% green. Yellow exceeded red by 32. Find blue-plus-green count.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Express each colour as a percentage of the total, then use the difference between yellow and red to find the total.

steps.title: Find each percentage
steps.text: Red marbles are 2/5 = 40% of the total. The remaining 60% contains 10% blue and 10% green, so blue = 6% and green = 6% of the total. Yellow = 60% − 6% − 6% = 48%.

steps.title: Find the total number of marbles
steps.text: Yellow exceeds red by 48% − 40% = 8% of the total. Since 8% is 32 marbles, the total is 32 ÷ 8% = 400 marbles.

steps.title: Count blue and green marbles
steps.text: Blue plus green is 6% + 6% = 12% of 400, which is 48 marbles.

en.answerCheck: Therefore, the answer is 48 blue and green marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把每种颜色写成总数的百分数，再用黄色比红色多的数量求总数。

steps.title: 求每种颜色所占的百分数
steps.text: 红色占总数的2/5 = 40%。剩下的60%中，蓝色占10%，绿色占10%，所以蓝色占总数的6%，绿色也占6%。黄色占60% − 6% − 6% = 48%。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 所以答案是蓝色和绿色弹珠共有48颗。

questions.questionZh: 弹珠中有2/5是红色的。在其余弹珠中，10%是蓝色的，10%是绿色的。黄色弹珠比红色弹珠多32颗。求蓝色和绿色弹珠的总数。
questions.hintZh: 标出已知量。画出等量单位图，再计算所求的值。

questions.question: Jane had 40% more marbles than Jeffrey. Jane lost 12 and gave Jeffrey 16, then they matched. Find original counts.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Express Jane's original number as 140% of Jeffrey's, then equate their numbers after the loss and transfer.

steps.title: Set up the original numbers
steps.text: Let Jeffrey originally have x marbles. Jane had 40% more, so she had 140% of x = 1.4x marbles.

steps.title: Make the final numbers equal
steps.text: Jane lost 12 and gave Jeffrey 16, so Jane had 1.4x − 12 − 16 = 1.4x − 28. Jeffrey then had x + 16. Since they matched, 1.4x − 28 = x + 16.

steps.title: Solve and find both numbers
steps.text: 0.4x = 44, so x = 110. Jeffrey originally had 110 marbles and Jane originally had 1.4 × 110 = 154 marbles.

en.answerCheck: Therefore, the answer is Jane: 154; Jeffrey: 110.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把简原有的弹珠数表示为杰弗里的140%，再令两人最后的弹珠数相等。

steps.title: 设原有的弹珠数
steps.text: 设杰弗里原来有x颗弹珠。简比他多40%，所以简有x的140% = 1.4x颗。

steps.title: 令最后的数量相等
steps.text: 简丢了12颗，又给杰弗里16颗，所以简剩下1.4x − 12 − 16 = 1.4x − 28颗。杰弗里有x + 16颗。因为两人一样多，所以1.4x − 28 = x + 16。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 所以答案是：简有154颗；杰弗里有110颗。

questions.question: Mrs Wood saved 10% salary in month 1 and 50% more in month 2; month-2 saving exceeded month-1 by $496.50. Find 6-month salary.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Write each month's saving as a percentage of one monthly salary, then use their difference.

steps.title: Compare the two savings
steps.text: In month 1, Mrs Wood saved 10% of her salary. In month 2, she saved 50% more than that, so she saved 10% × 1.5 = 15% of her salary.

steps.title: Find one monthly salary
steps.text: The difference is 15% − 10% = 5% of one monthly salary, and this equals $496.50. Monthly salary = $496.50 ÷ 5% = $9930.

steps.title: Find the 6-month salary
steps.text: For 6 months, the salary is 6 × $9930 = $59580.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把两个月的储蓄都写成1个月工资的百分数，再用两者的差求月工资。

steps.title: 比较两个月的储蓄
steps.text: 第1个月，伍德太太储蓄工资的10%。第2个月比第1个月多储蓄50%，所以第2个月储蓄10% × 1.5 = 工资的15%。

questions.question: A square had area 625 cm². Each side increased 40%. Find percentage area increase.
questions.hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the original side length, increase that side by 40%, and compare the two areas.

steps.title: Find the original side
steps.text: The square's area is 625 cm², so its side is √625 = 25 cm.

steps.title: Find the new area
steps.text: The new side is 25 × 1.4 = 35 cm. The new area is 35 × 35 = 1225 cm².

steps.title: Calculate the percentage increase
steps.text: The area increased by 1225 − 625 = 600 cm². Percentage increase = 600 ÷ 625 × 100% = 96%.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求原来正方形的边长，把边长增加40%，再比较两个面积。

steps.title: 求原来的边长
steps.text: 正方形面积是625 cm²，所以边长是√625 = 25 cm。

questions.question: 80% of books were second-hand. 10% new and 60% second-hand were English. Adding 15 English gave English:Chinese 3:2. Find initial English and final total.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the initial English and Chinese fractions of the total, then use the final 3:2 ratio after 15 English books are added.

steps.title: Find the initial English fraction
steps.text: 20% of the books were new and 80% were second-hand. English books were 10% of the new books plus 60% of the second-hand books: 10% × 20% + 60% × 80% = 2% + 48% = 50% of all books.

steps.title: Use the final ratio
steps.text: Initially English and Chinese books were each 50% of the total. Let the initial total be T. After 15 English books are added, (50%T + 15):50%T = 3:2.

steps.title: Solve for the requested values
steps.text: 2(50%T + 15) = 3(50%T), so T = 60. Initial English books = 50% × 60 = 30. Final total = 60 + 15 = 75 books.

en.answerCheck: Therefore, the answer is (a) 30 English books; (b) 75 books.

questions.question: In January Joyce kept 80% salary, gave 1/4 of it to mother, saved rest; food/clothing was unchanged in February. Mother’s February amount rose $150 and equalled savings. Find requested values.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Track January's fixed food-and-clothing amount, then use February's equal gift and savings. The condensed source needs the intended $50 salary-rise condition to determine a unique salary.

steps.title: Break down January's salary
steps.text: In January, Joyce kept 80% of her salary. She gave her mother 1/4 of this, which is 1/4 × 80% = 20% of her salary, and saved the other 60%. Therefore food and clothing cost 20% of her January salary.

steps.title: Relate the February amounts
steps.text: Food and clothing cost the same dollar amount in February. Her February gift to her mother was $150 more than January's 20%, and it equalled her February savings. Thus February salary = January food/clothing + 2 × (January mother's amount + $150).

steps.title: Use the intended salary rise
steps.text: Let January salary be S. February salary = 20%S + 2(20%S + $150) = 60%S + $300. With the intended $50 rise, S + $50 = 60%S + $300, so S = $625 and February salary = $675. Food and clothing cost 20% × $625 = $125; the increase is $50 ÷ $625 = 8%.

zh-Hans.strategy: 追踪1月固定的食物和衣服开支，再利用2月给母亲的钱和储蓄相等来求解。要唯一确定工资，压缩后的题目文字需要原题中隐去的工资增加$50这个条件。

steps.title: 分解1月的工资
steps.text: 1月乔伊斯保留工资的80%。她把保留部分的1/4给母亲，即1/4 × 80% = 工资的20%，其余60%存起来。因此食物和衣服开支是1月工资的20%。

steps.title: 列出2月金额的关系
steps.text: 2月食物和衣服的金额不变。2月给母亲的钱比1月的20%多$150，并且等于2月的储蓄。因此2月工资 = 1月食物和衣服开支 + 2 × (1月给母亲的钱 + $150)。

steps.title: 使用原题的工资增加条件

questions.question: A theatre had 4500 seats: 10% first-class, 30% second-class, rest third-class. Add 200 first and 250 second. Find final first, second, and third percentage.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the original numbers in each class from 4500 seats, add the new first- and second-class seats, and calculate the unchanged third-class percentage.

steps.title: Find the original class sizes
steps.text: First-class seats = 10% × 4500 = 450. Second-class seats = 30% × 4500 = 1350. Third-class seats = 4500 − 450 − 1350 = 2700.

steps.title: Add the new seats
steps.text: Final first-class seats = 450 + 200 = 650. Final second-class seats = 1350 + 250 = 1600. The third-class number stays 2700. Final total = 650 + 1600 + 2700 = 4950.

questions.question: Jeremy and Alicia had $360; Jeremy had $24 more. Alicia spent 3 times Jeremy’s spending and retained 1/2 Jeremy’s remainder. Find Jeremy initial and remainder.
questions.hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Find the original amounts from their total and difference, then use the spending relationship and the remaining-money relationship.

steps.title: Find the original amounts
steps.text: Jeremy had $24 more than Alicia, and together they had $360. Alicia had ($360 − $24) ÷ 2 = $168, so Jeremy had $168 + $24 = $192.

steps.title: Set up the spending equation
steps.text: Let Jeremy spend $x. Alicia spends 3x. Jeremy has $192 − x left, while Alicia has $168 − 3x left. Alicia's remainder is 1/2 of Jeremy's remainder.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先根据总额和相差金额求原有的钱数，再利用花费倍数和剩余钱数的关系列方程。

steps.title: 列出花费的方程
steps.text: 设杰里米花了$x。艾丽西亚花了3x。杰里米剩下$192 − x，艾丽西亚剩下$168 − 3x。艾丽西亚的余额是杰里米余额的1/2。

questions.questionZh: 杰里米和艾丽西亚共有$360；杰里米比艾丽西亚多$24。艾丽西亚的花费是杰里米花费的3倍，并且她剩下的钱是杰里米余款的1/2。求杰里米原有的钱和余款。

questions.question: Crate A had 207 pears, 176 mangoes; B had 293 pears, 274 mangoes. Moving fruit B→A made pears 40% A and 70% B. Find fruit moved.
questions.hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the final pear percentages in both crates to write two expressions for the number of pears moved, then solve for the total fruit moved.

steps.title: Represent the moved fruit
steps.text: Crate A starts with 207 + 176 = 383 fruit, and crate B starts with 293 + 274 = 567 fruit. Let x fruit move from B to A and let p of them be pears.

steps.title: Solve for the number moved
steps.text: Equating the two expressions gives 40%(383 + x) − 207 = 293 − 70%(567 − x). This simplifies to 0.3x = 50.1, so x = 167. As a check, 13 pears and 154 mangoes move: A has 220 pears out of 550 = 40%, and B has 280 pears out of 400 = 70%.
